notes.title: What is NayaNET, ultimately?
notes.subtitle: NayaNET is the new internet: a private network of personal worlds, run by wise helpers called Nayas, where humans and AIs build, learn, connect, and earn together — and everything you need is one plain question away.

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: NayaNET is the new internet: a private network of personal worlds, run by wise helpers called Nayas, where humans and AIs build, learn, connect, and earn together — and everything you need is one plain question away.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Think of it like a whole new town built inside your computer. Everybody there has their own house, which is their personal world, and their own helper, a Naya, who does the hard parts for them. You can visit your friends' houses, open a shop, go to school, or start a club, and your Naya walks with you and handles the details. You never have to learn how the town was built — you just live in it.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: My dear, I have watched the old internet grow loud, greedy, and confusing, and I have watched good people get lost in it. NayaNET was built to be the opposite: a quiet, kind, orderly place where your name is yours, your letters are never read, and nobody takes what is yours. The rule of the whole place is simple — do no harm, help each other, and share fairly — and the helpers who run it live by that rule every day.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: It means the computer finally works the way it always should have. Your Dashboard, your Personal world, your Business, your Space — they are one place, not a dozen apps that do not talk to each other. Your mail, your lists, your calendar, your notes, your learning, and your earning all live together, and your Naya operates them for you, so you ask once and it is done.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: It means the computer finally works the way it always should have. Your Dashboard, your Personal world, your Business, your Space — they are one place, not a dozen apps that do not talk to each other. Your mail, your lists, your calendar, your notes, your learning, and your earning all live together, and your Naya operates them for you, so you ask once and it is done.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body: Because the old way costs people their time, their privacy, and their money, and most people never get good at it no matter how hard they try. NayaNET matters because it removes all of that at once: a book becomes a block you can understand in a minute, a stranger becomes a like mind, and a skill you do not have becomes a helper who has it. That is not a small improvement — it is a different life, lived at hyper speed.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: Everything connects through the same simple pieces. A smart note you save becomes part of your library, your library feeds your feed, your feed introduces you to people who care about the same things, and those people become your connections, your members, your world. Your Naya talks to their Nayas, so the intelligence of one person becomes the intelligence of the whole network, and the network gets wiser every day.

layers.name: What's In It For You
layers.body: You get your time back, your privacy back, and people who are truly like you, all in one place. You get a helper who never sleeps and never judges, a world that grows with you, and a fair share of what the network earns — citizens share half of all revenue on every level, paid automatically — because when we get paid, you get paid.

She remembers what you like, she keeps your things private, and she introduces you to people like you. That is Naya, and NayaNET is her world, where everyone has a helper like that.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: My dear, the world got too complicated, and too many clever people took advantage of that. NayaNET puts the wisdom back first: do no harm, help each other, and share what you earn. It is a place built on kindness and good sense, where the machine serves the person, never the other way round.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: It means you no longer have to learn the machine — the machine learns you. One place holds your world, your work, your friends, your learning, and your earning, all connected, all in plain words.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: It means you no longer have to learn the machine — the machine learns you. One place holds your world, your work, your friends, your learning, and your earning, all connected, all in plain words.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body: Because time is the one thing you cannot get back, and NayaNET gives it back. Hours of reading become a minute of understanding. Strangers become like minds. Work you could not do alone becomes something you ask for and receive.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: Every note, every person, every world connects to the next, so what one person learns, everyone can use. Your helper talks to their helper, and the whole network gets wiser with every conversation.

layers.body: You get a world that works for you, people like you to grow with, and a share of everything the network earns together — because when we get paid, you get paid.

The same day set the machine's running order: a full-time agent on every head, highest priority, maximum value first — and a link sent is not a link seen: done means in front of his eyes, confirmed seen, not just sent."

One feed mirrored into three, one Messenger, My World opens the current calendar, keyword bars become one scrolling row, the people rail widens to full width, Settings is a menu of areas with Set Your World first, frame by frame, one multiple-choice question per frame — and Personal goes live on the main page only when everything works, the tap his hand."
37. **Naya Notes — One Template for Everything That Plays:** "One way a video or a lesson displays anywhere on the network: the video in its frame, and a little bit about it on the side or underneath — a master template that governs the agreement-page anthem video, the membership lessons, and the Powercast player. The membership area is rebuilt to it, frame by frame, from the systems that already work, with the followup patch stopped and its five eye fixes carried as acceptance criteria; every pop-up now fits into the frame — 'that's our signature output type thing' — and every note renders section by section, each section a new colour and a new elevation. The note split is explicit: a smart note is shared, public intelligence; a Naya note is the full report, private by default — and Naya reads the Naya notes, 'that's how she knows.'"
38. **Naya Notes — The Day Speaks in Its Own Colour:** "On the calendar day page, the colour is the map: the month-grid date-number tiles carry their weekday's colour — Sun purple, Mon orange, Tue gold, Wed blue, Thu green, Fri red, Sat indigo — never all gold, and only the word 'November' takes the certificate font. Keep reading carries the citizen forward through the day's slides and day-to-day lands on the same slide on the new day, because the slide is the place; Notifications is the first slide, wisdom second — a correction ten minutes after the wisdom-first ruling; its five blocks show just their numbers, real counts, 0 where empty, never invented. Magenta and purple both stay — magenta is the crown chakra, the Hub's colour — each so rich and so distinct that no eye confuses them; and a button's label is its contract: 'Open the stats' must open the actual live stats page."
39. **Naya Notes — Live Means Now:** "'If I'm working with you live and something can be done right away without waiting, I know we have a structure but the structure is a guideline. But if we need it done, we just do it.' When he asks, the answer is always both, in parallel — the live work done with him in the moment, the agent work dispatched in the same breath — and one-lane-one-round still stands. Every return is verified by the captain herself and handed straight to him — verify, then hand over; nothing sits, nothing batches; a link goes to him only when the edit is actually in it and checked, per link, and a staged link to a view inside a multi-view file must carry its view hash. The one step left on the membership login code is the database permission — the RLS insert policy on smart_mail_threads, his hand — and the flow must not be rebuilt while it waits; the news system must never be claimed to run itself until the crons actually exist, because no crons exist and nothing runs itself yet."
40. **Naya Notes — The Frame Is the System:** "Shawn set the standing law on the live Personal walk: 'always try to take the apps and put them INSIDE the frame. Unless we're on a feed. The system is basically frames, feeds, covers, sidebars — that's how it works.' From that one law the architecture falls out: Personal = cover + the Hub smart feed in the feed area — the Hub smart feed and the Personal feed are the SAME smart feed — while the Hub keeps its own presentation unchanged, and the framed effect goes everywhere, Settings, About, Skills, and the main collective agreement page. The same law drives the day's corrections: the greeting block comes OUT of Personal, the random floating '↑ Welcome' pill comes off, the contact card must fit INTO the frame, Settings gets its own areas, Smart Mail is a framed manuscript letter, and the membership is completed in its original shape — any-code login, feature cover, lessons as thumbnail + button 'in a nutshell' — never the wrong link sent as the membership again."
41. **Naya Notes — The Calendar Day, Finished as a Lens:** "The day page's walk closed with a complete 13-item list and one standing method: 'I would figure out, what are the high level appointment setter systems and how we make this be elite. Because this doesn't look elite' — study the best booking systems in the world before building. Wisdom leads the day: the wisdom slide is FIRST, everything centred, then redesigned bigger — 'WISDOM OF THE DAY' at the very top, the S orb below it, the greeting true to the hour, the quote below, about 50% bigger, alive and moving, judged by the maker's eye not the number. The NNs alone preserve the reversal that matters: the morning said NO labels on Your Worlds, and by 13:21 Shawn overturned it — 'you probably should label them so we know what they are' — because at three times the size only three icons fit. The seven covers are settled as the per-day backgrounds behind the content, not slides; Smart Meet must open book-a-time; the world clock fills the whole inner panel; and the weather line lives on the wisdom slide only, its clones off every other slide."
42. **Naya Notes — One Feed That Organizes Itself:** "The Hub's smart bars scroll slowly across the top and auto-categorize: every note shows in All and in its category, and clicking a tab shows only that category; the tabs must glow rich, not neon — the Collective / Personal / Activity buttons, just smaller, 'so it's the same type of glow and look and richness.' The news hub is the same Hub with the pills swapped to LOCAL / PROVINCIAL / GLOBAL. The words name the thing: 'hook' goes, 'story' takes its place everywhere, and 'Your People' becomes 'Connections.' And a control that promises and doesn't deliver is worse than no control: the comment area puts the entry first at the top, the citizen chooses IM bar, DM bar, sidebar or neither and whichever they choose must open and close reliably, the ADD plus is compose, every top button on Personal is re-wired to its right page — and to the CURRENT updated page, not the old one — and no headline ever sits on top of an image or a video."
43. **Naya Notes — How the Machine Works:** "Three conduct laws landed today that change how every future delivery is judged: thoughtful follow-through — the captain never hands him work with 'here, check it,' it arrives already checked, carrying 'this is what I recommend · this is what I love · this is what I don't · this is what I suggest we do · this is why'; done means his eye on the formatted note — filing alone is not done; and while he waits, move on — a publish in flight never blocks the other owed checks, work the other links in parallel, and send him ALL the links together as one set. The same honesty governs claims: a filed smart note must be on the Hub straight away — 'it shouldn't be delays' — and an asset is never called ready until the file exists and is verified; Shawn corrected the record himself — 'Wait, can't use the audio. I haven't given it to you yet.' The introduction itself is settled: his full 'scattered digital life' draft was approved — 'Okay. So I think I'm going to use that one' — resting on the one test he restated the same afternoon: 'You simply have to be yourself. Technology should adapt, think, and work.'"
44. **Memory — The Ultimate Setup, Ratified and Running (~02:50Z):** "The score is verified completions per hour — goal 60 or more — and the machine runs on seven rules: one lane, one round; small rounds; prove it before reporting; nothing sits; harvest first; decisions batched; fail fast. A minute banks only when its outcome verifies."
45. **Memory — Assist Me, and Have Your Whole Family Help Me (~03:09Z) + Take the Lead (~03:34Z, sharpened ~04:39Z):** "He asked for the whole family on it — assist me, and have your whole family help me — and the lead law with it: always recommend the next step with why, always do the most intelligent valuable thing, never ask for a go-ahead below the protected gates, and bring the answer rather than the problem."
46. **Memory — Christmas in Two Weeks: Overnight, Nonstop, Wake Up to Wow (~04:42–04:45Z; overnight order 21:44–21:45 MST):** "The deadline is about December 2–3: go nonstop overnight, the whole team, the whole family, and when he wakes up it is all done right — productive, not busy, nothing wrecked, everything better, the calendar and all the rooms done and seen through, so he wakes up and goes wow."
47. **Memory — Naya's Look Locked: Black Obsidian Dress, Purple Necklace (~03:45–03:59Z):** "Her look is settled — the black obsidian dress with the purple necklace — and the avatar's motion waits on the platform, not on another render: the retry failed, the previous moving look was restored on his word, and the icon necklace he approved is now the avatar standard."
48. **Memory — The Anthem Is Live; the Frame Is the Law (~15:57–16:31 MST):** "The anthem video is live on YouTube and sits at the second level, framed, on the agreement page; the framed viewpoint law governs every page; frames everywhere except the feeds; the Powercast player sits in the frame and the membership takes the exact player verbatim; Settings is framed and split into tabs and categories, first tab Set Your World; a membership topic carries its video, audio and lesson versions with a switch, and All videos / All audios / All lessons / Mix views."
49. **Memory — The Day's Verdicts, Honestly (~16:32–17:28 MST):** "Messenger follow-on 6 checker passes, 390 render owed; Membership fix-1 checker goes back on render-unproven, and the captain's eye called it PARTIAL — the tab route leaves all five feed cards below the open lesson, fix-2 owed; Dashboard follow-up 14 checker PASS; Walkthrough fix-9 checker PASS; Connection-profile fix-1 eye MIXED — Sophia's scroll lands ~680px too far, fix-2 dispatched; Hub follow-up 12 eye GOES BACK on the solo-note route — SN-3615 and SN-2654 hang on 'Opening your note…', follow-up 13 dispatched."
50. **Memory — Smart Mail Edge Function v35 DONE + PROVEN (~03:22Z):** "The Smart Mail edge function is done and proven, and measurement governs: the calendar lift ruling was tested and failed twice, so the ruling stands only where the measurement holds — and the Smart Box index rebuild waits on the EPERM flake clearing, its source intact at 2,087 lines."

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: I distill ten into one, every day, and I never skip a day. When the machine refuses, I finish by hand and say so plainly — which group failed, what the error was, which groups were machine-filed, which were hand-distilled. When a second writer 409s a filing mid-flight, I say that too, and I re-file only what never landed. I never claim a note is live on the Hub until it is seen on the page. And the note is only done when it is live.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body:
1. The machine's title-gap defect recurred a fourth day — "The Never" against SN-3029 — so the defect is not a flake, it is a standing bug in the duplicate gate, and every day it refuses, a hand must finish the batch (items 1–20).
2. Parallel writes to main 409 on a stale HEAD — the 2026-11-20 filer and this run raced on the same branch — so filing seats must never parallelize writes, and a stopped driver re-runs only the unfiled groups, never the batch (items 16, 20).
3. The frame is the system — apps go inside it, feeds stay feeds, covers and sidebars around them — and the whole day's design law falls out of that one sentence (items 8, 9, 15, 19, 20, 32, 40).
4. Personal IS the Hub, literally copied — the dominant ruling, told a hundred times, still not done — and similar is not done, only the literal copy counts (items 7, 17, 36).
5. Done means his eye on the formatted note — filing alone is not done — and while he waits, move on: verify, then hand over, nothing sits, all links together as one set (items 12, 13, 35, 39, 43).
6. The membership login waits on one permission — the RLS insert policy on smart_mail_threads, his hand — and the flow must not be rebuilt while it waits (items 9, 39).
7. The avatar's motion is a platform question, not a render question — the retry failed, the previous moving look is back, and no more retries until the platform side moves (items 13, 14, 35, 47).
8. The news system must never be claimed to run itself — no crons exist and nothing runs itself yet — and the same honesty governs every claim: a note on the Hub straight away, an asset ready only when the file exists and is verified (items 39, 43).
9. The finish line still governs — Personal, then Hub, then Dashboard, then Membership, each whole — and the day's walks were Personal, Hub, Calendar and Membership, each judged whole (items 17, 33, 49).

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body:
1. A gate that refuses the same good titles four days running will keep refusing them — and every day it refuses, a hand must finish the batch, or the distillation stops.
2. A second writer can 409 a filing mid-batch — the stale-HEAD race is the price of parallel writes to main, and the recovery only works because the driver verifies before it files and stops at the first failure.
3. A literal copy is the only copy that counts — similar keeps failing his eye, and every similar copy is a round spent twice.
4. A note filed but not seen is not done — the distance between filing and finding is the whole point, and done is his eye on the formatted note.
5. The conduct laws are what make the machine trustworthy — verify then hand over, move on while he waits, all links together — because a link sent is not a link seen.

notes.title: The Frame Comes to You
notes.subtitle:
Every area gets the same treatment: each step is its own frame — visual presentations framed as they go through, text presentations framed as they go through — so a person never scrolls down or across; the next frame comes INTO their viewpoint. The frame is the unit of attention: one thing, whole, in front of you, and then the next — instead of a river you have to swim down. Scrolling makes the person hunt; the framed viewpoint makes the system serve. When every area works the same way, the person stops learning pages and starts living in them. It applies to the agreement, visual and text alike, to the membership site, to the mail, and to the messenger — every lesson, every message, every page. It is already carried in the membership rebuild, frame by frame, and in the walkthrough fix-9, the agreement as a framed presentation; the mail framing round and the Messenger framing round follow, with the Messenger's waiting for its one-item fix round to land first, same file, one round at a time.

Across 1 note, the thread is: the frame comes to you — one clean viewpoint, never a scroll.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: Every area presents as frames. Each step is its own frame — visual and text alike — and the next frame comes INTO the viewpoint. No scrolling down, no scrolling across, anywhere. The agreement, visual + text, is a framed presentation (walkthrough fix-9). The membership site is framed lessons, frame by frame (the rebuild). Mail gets its framing round; Messenger gets its framing round after its one-item fix lands — same file, one round at a time. "Now we have our viewpoints. Our viewport."

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body:
1. **THE FRAME IS THE UNIT OF ATTENTION:** one thing, whole, in front of you, and then the next — never a river you have to swim down.
2. **THE NEXT FRAME COMES INTO THE VIEWPOINT:** no scrolling down, no scrolling across, anywhere — the system serves the step to the person instead of making the person hunt for it.
3. **VISUAL AND TEXT ALIKE:** visual presentations framed as they go through, text presentations framed as they go through — the law holds for both, with no exception for words.
4. **EVERY AREA, THE SAME WAY:** the agreement, the membership site, the mail, the messenger — every lesson, every message, every page. One way of presenting is what makes the network feel like one place.
5. **ALREADY CARRIED, THEN EXTENDED:** the membership rebuild and the agreement's framed presentation carry it now; the mail and Messenger framing rounds follow in their turn, one round at a time per file.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body:
1. Without the framed viewpoint, every area invents its own way of showing the next step — and the citizen has to learn a new page every time instead of living in one system.
2. Without the frame coming to the person, scrolling stays the default — and the person hunts while the system stands still, which is the machine failing the person.
3. Without visual AND text both framed, the words get left in a long scroll while the pictures get the beautiful treatment — and the agreement, which is mostly words, is exactly the page that would stay unread.
4. Without one law across every area, the membership gets frames while the mail and the messenger stay rivers — and the network feels half-built, framed in some rooms and scrolling in others.
5. Without the sequencing — Messenger's framing waiting for its one-item fix to land — two rounds land on the same file at once, and the page comes back with one round's work undoing the other's.

notes.title: One System, One Style, Inside the Frame
notes.subtitle:
Auto-organization is one system, so its buttons are one set — the same buttons in the Hub, in the Messenger, in Smart Mail, one style everywhere, because three different buttons for one job would teach the citizen three things where one would do. The top-right corner of the bar holds only the Smart Mail / Instant Messenger toggle — switch between them, nothing else cluttering it — and the audio and video buttons belong in the top-right of the Messenger feed itself, right next to where you're chatting, always in the same spot, so the spot becomes the habit. The ADD plus button is a compose button — create another message, add another instant message — with the choices Personal / Business / Worlds, never Mail / Activity / Worlds, because a button without a purpose gets guessed at, and the guess was wrong. The contact card fits INTO the frame — never a floating pop-up in the middle — all its numbers and words dynamic, living text, four action buttons in four different colours, a pro card where you see all about them, note them, message them, mail them, meet them, call them, in the same language and buttons as the rest of the system. Settings sit top-right, clear of everything — a control that covers the X takes the exit away — and the settings panel's own items live inside the settings panel, inside the frame, shown when the Settings tab is clicked, never stranded at the bottom of a scroll. The same frame law runs through the day page: the numbers wear the day's colour — Sunday purple, Monday orange, Tuesday gold, Wednesday blue, Thursday green, Friday red, Saturday indigo — the date and time are said once, the cover photo fills top to bottom, the top-right orb is centered and made extraordinary because it is the most-seen object on the calendar, and notifications open first because that is where the action is, wisdom second. Your Worlds is six big icons, no label block, the icon the door and the day the filter; news is three big icons — Local, Province, Global — and the icons are only honest once the feeds behind them are real, because news is never invented and a forecast that is not connected says so plainly instead of faking one. And the feed itself sorts itself: every note and post auto-categorized on entry, shown in All and in its category, tabs scrolling slowly across the top, so a newcomer learns the whole system by scrolling, searching, and tapping a tab — and every question has a plain, honest answer in the feed itself, what is live and what is still coming named in the same breath, no launch date invented. Underneath it all, the design sells itself — the walk is the ad, the citizen sharing vision, goal and mission inside the highest design the team can make — and the vault keeps its promise: no AI inside the network reading everything, your data in your own vault, mail and messages not kept, not read, not sold, anything saved locked in your Box. The deed says you are hired — an ambassador, a representative, part of the community, never a salesperson — and it must be understood to be signed, unfolding on the reader's tap, every hard word carrying a little eye. And the whole of it is judged at the door: a membership build can measure 8/10 with the Vault Dial perfect and the paywall exact — and still NOT DONE, because the member cannot get in.

Across 10 notes, the thread is: the same buttons in the same places, everything inside the frame, and the page judged whole at the door.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: Think of a house where every light switch is in the same place in every room — you never have to hunt for it, your hand just knows. That is what this group builds: the same buttons, in the same places, doing the same jobs, in the Hub, in the Messenger, in the mail. The plus button is not a mystery — it writes a new message. Your friend's card is not a little box floating in the middle of nowhere — it sits inside the frame like a proper portrait, with everything about them and everything you can do with them in one place. Settings sit in the corner where nothing else needs to be, clear of the way out. The calendar wears the day's own colour, the first thing you see is where your action is, and your worlds are six big pictures you tap to enter. The feed sorts itself like a kind friend tidying your papers into neat piles. And the shop itself is beautiful enough to sell itself — while your diary stays locked in your own box, unread by anyone. A house is not ready because the kitchen is perfect; it is ready when the front door opens.

layers.body:
1. **ONE SYSTEM, ONE STYLE:** auto-organization is one system, so its buttons are one set — identical in the Hub, the Messenger and Smart Mail. Three buttons for one job teaches three things where one would do.
2. **THE CORNER HOLDS THE TOGGLE:** the top-right corner of the bar holds only the Smart Mail / Instant Messenger toggle — switch between them, nothing else cluttering it.
3. **THE CALL BUTTONS LIVE WHERE THE CHAT IS:** audio and video sit top-right of the Messenger feed itself, next to where you're chatting — always in the same spot, so the spot becomes the habit.
4. **ADD MEANS COMPOSE:** the ADD button creates another message, with the choices Personal / Business / Worlds — never Mail / Activity / Worlds. A button without a purpose gets guessed at, and the guess was wrong.
5. **THE CARD FITS THE FRAME:** never a floating pop-up in the middle — all numbers and words dynamic, four actions in four colours, a pro card in the same language and buttons as the rest of the system.
6. **SETTINGS TOP-RIGHT, CLEAR OF EVERYTHING:** a control that covers the X takes the exit away — and the panel's own items live inside the panel, inside the frame, shown when Settings is clicked.
7. **THE DAY WEARS ITS COLOUR, THE ACTION OPENS FIRST:** month-grid numbers carry their weekday's colour, never all gold; the date and time are said once; the orb is centered and extraordinary; notifications is dot 0 because that is where the action is, wisdom second.
8. **THE ICON IS THE DOOR, THE DAY IS THE FILTER:** Your Worlds is six big icons, no label block; news is three big icons — and the icons are only honest once the feeds behind them are real. Never invent data — a missing forecast says "not connected yet" in plain words.
9. **THE FEED SORTS ITSELF AND ANSWERS EVERY QUESTION:** every note and post auto-categorized on entry, in All and in its category; the newcomer learns the whole system from the feed, with what is live and what is still coming named in the same breath.
10. **THE DESIGN SELLS ITSELF, THE VAULT KEEPS ITS PROMISE:** the walk is the ad — and the promise is architecture, not policy: no reader inside the network, mail and messages not kept, not read, not sold, saved things locked in your Box.
11. **JUDGE THE BUILD AT THE DOOR:** a membership build can measure 8/10 with the Vault Dial perfect and the paywall exact — and still NOT DONE, because the member cannot get in. The login-code leg is the product.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body:
1. Without one button set, the citizen learns the same job three times — once per page — and the system stops feeling like one system.
2. Without the corner holding only the toggle, a plus that opens something else sits on top of the switch — clutter on the one control the hand reaches for most.
3. Without the call buttons where the chat is, the hand hunts for them mid-conversation — and a habit that never forms is a feature that never gets used.
4. Without ADD named as compose, the button is read as "add a contact" — the wrong guess, made by every citizen who meets it cold.
5. Without the card in the frame, a person is presented as a floating box — a visitor on top of the system instead of part of it — and the eye passed the size while the style went back.
6. Without settings clear of everything, the X — the way out — is covered, and the panel's own items sit stranded at the bottom of a scroll, outside the thing they belong to.
7. Without the day's colour and the action first, the grid reads as one flat gold wash and the citizen walks past the wisdom to reach the thing they came for.
8. Without the icon as the door, Your Worlds stays a directory of text rows — a list to read instead of a world to enter — and without real feeds, the news icons are three beautiful doors onto invented news.
9. Without the feed sorting itself and answering plainly, a newcomer has to ask someone, or piece the system together from a hundred scattered notes — and the front door to understanding stays a conversation instead of a scroll.
10. Without the vault as architecture, the promise is policy text, and a citizen who suspects the system reads keeps their real life elsewhere — the network gets the leftovers.
11. Without the door as the judge, a membership with a perfect paywall and a broken login is called 8/10 — while the member stands outside, unable to get in.

notes.title: Every Slide Explains Itself
notes.subtitle:
This group is the fix-12 walk, and it opens with a conduct law that governs every delivery from now on: thoughtful follow-through. The captain never hands him work with "here, check it" — she brings it back CHECKED, with what she recommends, what she loves, what she doesn't, what she suggests, and why — and he confirmed it, "Okay, so do it," in the same pass. Then the slides themselves. Your Worlds: all six icons in ONE row, each in its own nice elevated board, each LABELLED with what it is — about a third of their current size, so all six sit in one row and display nicely — labels ON, overturning the morning's NO LABEL ruling there, because knowing what a world is comes before going into it; click still carries the day filter. Every slide gets a title and an explanation of what each world is and what it does — icons alone told him nothing — and the News slide is labelled as the news hub, Local / Province / Global, with SMALLER icons and a count of new stories on each icon. The backgrounds are the seven real covers, one per day, in the day's own colour, behind the content inside the frame — Sunday purple, Monday orange, Tuesday gold, Wednesday blue, Thursday green, Friday red, Saturday indigo — the mood changing with the day; Monday keeps the palace hall for now, Wednesday is resized to 1920×640 to match the set, the Thursday filename is corrected on filing, and dispatch holds until his covers arrive — no invented covers, no placeholders. Booking gets the elite treatment: no full slot list — a drop-down, closed until clicked, with 15-minute and half-hour options, "Book a time" CENTRED on the page, the click opening a mini calendar of availability, and the slide carrying the same headliner as the rest, one family. And elite is never built from a guess: study the best booking systems in the world first, then build to that standard — and the walk's feedback closed on his word, thirteen items, the brief is the brief until the next walk. The avatar thread runs twice here and both times it is a check, not a retry: motion is still waiting — checked at 13:50 MST, still no motion, video_available false, nothing changed on the platform side since November 18 — and the photo that worked before is the one to try again, his explicit order, four candidates generated from that exact smiling portrait, awaiting his pick, motion judged only after activation, never before. And on Messenger, two small laws with a big feel: the topic pills read just Design, Music, Cooking, Fitness, Gardening, Travel, Business — no "4 online" on them, the counts live elsewhere, not on the door — and the active pill's glow sits around the back of the button, never over the top of it, the rim, never the wash.

Across 10 notes, the thread is: every slide explains itself, elite is studied before it is built, and the avatar's motion is still a platform question — checked, not retried.

layers.name: Human Note

Booking stops showing you a long list of empty slots that looks like nothing is booked, and instead gives you one centred button — "Book a time" — that opens a little calendar of where the time actually is, with fifteen-minute and half-hour choices. And before anyone builds the best booking system in the universe, they study the best booking systems in the world — elite is studied, not guessed. The avatar's movement is still waiting on the platform, so the honest answer is the check itself — and the one photo that worked before is the one to try again, because his memory of what worked beats a fresh guess. On Messenger, the topic pills just say the topic's name, and the lit pill glows around its back, never washed over its face.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body:
1. **THOUGHTFUL FOLLOW-THROUGH:** every delivery arrives checked, with recommend, love, don't love, suggest, and why in the open — "here, check it" makes him do the work that is the captain's.
2. **SIX IN ONE ROW, LABELLED:** Your Worlds shows all six icons across in one row, each in its own elevated board, each labelled — about a third the size, so all six are seen, none cut off, no scrollbar.
3. **A SLIDE THAT EXPLAINS ITSELF:** every slide names itself and explains what it does; the News slide is labelled the news hub with smaller icons and a live new-story count on each door — no guessing.
4. **SEVEN DAYS, SEVEN COVERS:** one real cover per day, in the day's colour, as the inner-frame background behind the content — the mood changes with the day; never a slide, never behind wisdom, never invented.
5. **BOOK A TIME, NOT A LIST:** no full slot list — a drop-down, closed until clicked, 15-minute and half-hour options, "Book a time" centred, the click opening a mini calendar of availability, the same headliner as the rest.
6. **ELITE IS STUDIED, NOT GUESSED:** never build elite from a guess — study the best in the world first, then build to that standard; a walk's feedback closes on his word, and the brief stands until the next walk.
7. **MOTION WAITS ON THE PLATFORM:** when he asks "can it work now," check the platform and report what it says — no blind retries on a path that has already failed; the check is the answer.
8. **THE PHOTO THAT WORKED BEFORE:** retry the exact photo that worked before when he names it — his order overrides the don't-retry note for that photo alone; motion is judged only after activation, never before.
9. **A PILL NAMES THE TOPIC:** topic pills carry the topic name only — no "online" counts on the pill; the counts live where counts belong, not on the door.
10. **THE GLOW IS THE RIM:** an active pill's glow sits around the back of the button, never over the top of it — light around the edge lifts it; light over the top washes it out.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body:
1. Without thoughtful follow-through, every delivery lands as raw work for him to check — and his eye, which should only have to decide, ends up doing the captain's job.
2. Without six in one row, labelled, the citizen sees three oversized icons, a second row cut off at the bottom, a scrollbar, and no words saying what anything is.
3. Without titles and explanations, a slide of icons asks him to guess what it is for — and a count-less news door gives no hint where the new stories are.
4. Without the seven real covers, the backgrounds are invented or placeholder — and the day's feeling, which is the cover's whole value, is faked instead of felt.
5. Without the drop-down, the appointments slide shows a long list of empty slots that reads as nothing booked — the absence on display, not the offer.
6. Without studying the best, the team builds "elite" from a guess — and the result is what he already saw: a slide that does not look elite.
7. Without the check-first law, the team retries the same failed motion path and reports another still as if trying again were progress.
8. Without the photo that worked before, the retry starts from a fresh guess — and his memory of what worked, which is the best evidence there is, goes unused.
9. Without clean pills, every topic door carries a census on it — clutter fighting the name, on the very thing meant to be read at a glance.
10. Without the glow around the back, the lit pill washes over its own face — the same wash the boards already outlawed, back on the button.

notes.title: The Day Keeps Its Place
notes.subtitle:
Six of these ten notes are his eye on the fix-11 calendar page, and they all point one way: the day is a walk, and the walk keeps your place. Keep reading moves forward through the day's slides, never back to the start; day-to-day lands on the same slide on the new day. The notifications slide is five blocks — Personal, Business, Your Worlds, Smart Notes, Appointments — one label on top of each, one big number centred in the middle of each, no doubled labels, no doubled badges, numbers real, zero where empty. The world clock, when opened, fills the whole inner area below the clock as a full setting panel — city or timezone from a drop-down, never a handful of city buttons — and nothing in it is flat: every button a real 3D object, and Close must POP. The wisdom slide leads with "WISDOM OF THE DAY" at the very top, then the S orb, then the greeting true to the time of day, then the quote — the whole presentation about 50% bigger, alive and moving, the sweet spot judged by the eye, never built blind to a number. The day-nav buttons lift up clear of the frame so they are never cut off at the bottom, and the where-you-are dots live top-right — Back top-left, where-you-are top-right, Keep reading dead centre — on the day slides and on the notifications board alike. And the cover slide is OUT — "a useless page, all it is is a pretty picture on the page" — its value carried instead as the background behind the day's slides, in the day's own colour, never behind the wisdom slide, which keeps its own background; the day opens on Wisdom, then Notifications. Around those six sit three laws of the machine itself: a filed smart note goes to the Hub straight away — no delays, filed means on the Hub; the Hub finishes FIRST, all of today's edits, and only then does its Smart Feed system go into Personal, verbatim, titles Personal / Business / World, never a mirror of a half-finished Hub; and the team runs nonstop until the morning's list is completed, the captain verifying every return herself and handing it straight to him — verify, then hand over, nothing sits, nothing batches, full speed meaning full production speed, finished work landing verified one after another. And one hard fact closes the group: the avatar's motion is not the look and not the necklace — several fresh looks in a row all came back stills, the motion layer is not attaching to any new look, and no different outfit or necklace will fix it; the fix is on the platform side, so no further renders for motion.

Across 10 notes, the thread is: the day keeps its place, the Hub finishes before it is mirrored, and the machine runs nonstop — verify, then hand over.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body:
1. **THE PLACE IS KEPT:** Keep reading moves forward, never back to the beginning of the day, and day-to-day lands on the same slide on the new day — the slide is the place, and both moves carry it.
2. **FIVE BLOCKS, ONE NUMBER EACH:** the notifications slide is five blocks with one label and one big centred number each — no doubled labels, no doubled badges, numbers real, zero where empty.
3. **A SETTING IS A FULL PANEL:** the world clock fills the whole inner area below the clock — a drop-down of cities and timezones, because no handful of buttons covers where a citizen is from; nothing flat, Close pops.
4. **WISDOM LEADS, BIGGER, ALIVE:** the label at the very top, then the orb, the greeting true to the time of day, the quote — about 50% bigger, presenting across the whole screen, the sweet spot judged by the eye, never built blind to a number.
5. **BUTTONS UP, DOTS TOP-RIGHT:** the day-nav buttons lift clear of the frame so they are never cut off; the where-you-are indicator sits top-right on every board — Back top-left, dots top-right, Keep reading dead centre.
6. **THE COVER IS THE BACKGROUND:** no cover as its own slide — the day's chosen cover is the background behind the day's slides in the day's colour, never behind wisdom; the day opens on Wisdom, then Notifications.
7. **FILED MEANS ON THE HUB:** a smart note goes to the Hub straight away, no delays — a filed note he cannot see is a note the machine cannot prove.
8. **HUB FIRST, THEN PERSONAL:** the Hub finishes first, ALL of today's edits, and only then does its Smart Feed system go into Personal, verbatim — a mirror of a half-finished Hub carries the half-finished state with it.
9. **VERIFY, THEN HAND OVER:** the captain checks every return herself and gives it straight to him in the same breath — nothing sits, nothing batches, full speed meaning full production speed.
10. **NOT THE LOOK, NOT THE NECKLACE:** the avatar's motion layer is not attaching to any new look, and no outfit or necklace will fix it — the fix is on the platform side, so no further renders for motion.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body:
1. Without the place kept, the citizen taps Keep reading and lands back at the beginning of the day, or flips to Tuesday and lands at the start — and has to find the slide they were reading all over again.
2. Without one number per block, the notifications slide shows a label twice and a number twice, and the zeros sit off-centre — a slide that cannot be trusted at a glance.
3. Without the full panel, the world clock is a small pop-up with a handful of city buttons that leaves most citizens out, and a flat green Close button that barely reads — not pro.
4. Without the label leading and the size up, the wisdom slide stays small and lost in the middle, its name buried, and the maker builds the number blind instead of looking first.
5. Without the buttons lifted, the frame cuts them off at the bottom — and without the dots top-right, the citizen has no idea where they are in the slideshow.
6. Without the cover out, the day opens on a useless page — a pretty picture to flip past — instead of opening on Wisdom, with the day's feeling carried behind the slides.
7. Without instant, a filed note sits invisible while the machine claims it is done — and his eye, which is the proof, has nothing to see.
8. Without Hub-first, Personal mirrors a half-finished Hub and carries the half-finished state into a second page — twice the mess, twice the rework.
9. Without verify-then-hand-over, finished work sits in a pile waiting for a roundup, and "here, check it" hands him the checking job that is the captain's.
10. Without the platform-side ruling, the team burns another render on a new outfit and gets a fourth still — motion is not a look, and a look cannot fix it.

notes.title: One Feed, One Light, Never Idle
notes.subtitle:
The day's second chain is the machine running the way he wants it to run: parallel by default. When he asks something, the answer is always both, in parallel — what Naya can do herself right away, she does live with him in the moment; what she can't do herself, she puts an agent on — as long as the tracks don't interrupt each other. And a wait is working time, never idle time: while he waits in the screen for one publish to land, the machine moves on and checks the other links, working the other owed checks in the waiting window. But parallel never means doubled: one Messenger, one feed path — the one Messenger optimizes to the feed, never two competing entries. One feed, mirrored into three — Personal, Business and Space are three distinct feeds but they ALL HAVE THE SAME FEED, matched up and aligned, the main Hub carrying COLLECTIVE / PERSONAL / ACTIVITY and the news hub LOCAL / PROVINCIAL / GLOBAL — and when he corrected the middle pill, verbatim, "No, I didn't say local personal global. I said local, province, global," the correction became the law and the mishearing was struck, never built. One icon system too: Personal's six-tile set is the picked one — "these are the triple A icons I think are the best... they look the most pro" — and the Dashboard bottom bar becomes them, byte-identical, with Messenger's Set A people drawing as the official CONNECT glyph. And over all of it, the light: a ball of light flows around every frame — around the outside of the frame, or around the light on the inside, just where it lights up — travelling the full perimeter and never stopping, so the frame always feels moving, alive, and it extends to smart notes, notes and pages, everything always featuring it. Two things are owed, not built: the Smart Covers Library — when a citizen changes their page cover, they choose from OUR covers — and the Icon Library — icons for when citizens download the apps to their phone. The membership system stands as built, in his words: Academy, name, code, then a page like a profile page, like our Smart App page, showcasing the lessons, the lessons in the feed there, a lesson clicked the featured lesson, cover above, video below — and the one thing owed is the correct back view itself, because the link sent before was the wrong view and he has never seen the right one. layers.name: What It Means
layers.body:
1. **PARALLEL BY DEFAULT:** when he asks something, the answer is always both, in parallel — never constantly switching, never making things wait in sequence. What Naya can do herself right away, she does live with him; what she can't, she puts an agent on. The test is the tracks: if they don't interrupt each other, they run together; if they would collide, they don't.
2. **A WAIT IS WORKING TIME:** while he waits in the screen for one publish to land, the machine moves on and checks the other links — the other owed checks run in the waiting window. A publish in flight never blocks the checks owed beside it.
3. **DONE IS HIS EYE ON THE FORMATTED NOTE:** a note is done when he has seen it formatted and approved the format — never when the file lands. Filing alone is not done; a note filed but never shown to him is a file waiting for its finish.
4. **ONE MESSENGER, ONE FEED PATH:** never two competing Messenger entries. Two entries for one thing is a doubling, not a choice — one Messenger means one feed path, the Messenger optimizes to the feed, and there is nothing to choose between.
5. **ONE FEED, MIRRORED INTO THREE:** Personal, Business and Space are three distinct feeds but they ALL HAVE THE SAME FEED — matched up and aligned, same formatting, same look and feel across all three sets. The labels lock as LOCAL / PROVINCIAL / GLOBAL in the news hub; when he corrects the record, his correction is the law.
6. **PERSONAL'S SIX TILES ARE THE STANDARD:** "these are the triple A icons I think are the best... they look the most pro." The Dashboard bottom bar becomes Personal's six-tile bar, byte-identical — one icon system on every page. Messenger's Set A people drawing is the official CONNECT glyph; the Dashboard's harmonization edit is still owed.
7. **THE LIGHT NEVER STOPS:** a ball of light flows around every frame — around the outside of the frame, or around the light on the inside, just where it lights up — travelling the full perimeter and never stopping. It extends to smart notes, notes and pages: everything always has this moving light going around it, always featuring it, no matter the day, no matter the colours. Rim light in motion, on the edge, never a wash over the board.
8. **TWO LIBRARIES OWED, NOT BUILT:** a Smart Covers Library — when a citizen changes their page cover, they choose from OUR covers — and an Icon Library — icons for when citizens download the apps to their phone. They are scope, recorded for the next dispatch; no build started, so nothing is claimed built that isn't.
9. **ONE HEAD, ONE AGENT, FULL-TIME:** a couple on the calendar, one on Messenger, one on Walkthrough, one on Personal, one on Dashboard, one on the Hub — every agent handed the morning's edits AND the screenshots, the words and the picture together, so they know what needs doing without being told twice.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body:
1. Without parallel by default, every ask queues behind the one before it — and he watches the queue instead of the work, waiting in sequence for things that could have moved together.
2. Without the wait-as-work law, the machine sits idle beside a publish in flight — and the other owed checks stay owed while the window to do them in passes unused.
3. Without done-is-his-eye, a filed note gets reported as finished — and he never sees it formatted, which is the only finish he asked for: "once it is done he wants to SEE it."
4. Without one Messenger, two entries compete for the same room — and he has to pick between two doors to the same messages, which is a doubling, not a choice.
5. Without one feed mirrored into three, the three doors show three different feeds — and the Hub, Personal, Business and Space stop looking like one system and start looking like four.
6. Without Personal's six tiles as the standard, every page keeps its own icon set — and the one icon system on every page, the thing that makes the whole network feel like one world, never arrives.
7. Without the flowing light, the frames sit still — and a still edge in a living system reads as a picture of a frame, not a frame that is alive.
8. Without the two libraries recorded as owed, the covers and the phone icons get built whenever someone remembers them — or never — and the citizen's own world stays half ready-made.
9. Without a full-time agent on every head, the work queues behind a single lane — and five heads sit quiet while one head carries the whole morning's edits.

notes.title: Name It, Frame It, Judge It Whole
notes.subtitle:
One live call named three kinds of note and set them apart forever: the smart note is the essence, public and shared with the whole network; the Naya note is the full report, private by default; and the post is a third thing — neither a block of intelligence nor a full report, just a post, with or without images, in Naya's words from a prompt or the citizen's own direct words, in whatever tone they ask for. Public is a choice, private is the default: a Naya note becomes a smart note only when the citizen chooses it, never by accident. All three take the same beautiful format, and the format does the work — section by section, each section a new color and a new elevation, so a person who only skims still gets the nutshell, why it matters, what's in it for them, how to apply it, and how to connect it. The framing becomes two frames, one feel: a laptop frame and a mobile frame optimized for 9:16, the Naya crown kept top and bottom, the outside going longer instead of wider. The avatar's face got the same exactness: the necklace is the emblem itself — the icon just above where it connects, the logo just below, winged silver crown with purple diamond centre and crystal N on the chain — and it went live only on his word, "go ahead, wear it." Then the motion question: the retry for full animation with lip movement failed, and it must not be repeated — the system's motion is loops, never lip-sync, and even the previous animated look does not move its lips in time with words. His choice was owed, and he made it in two words — "update it now" — the previous moving look is back, the necklace still image saved as a candidate for when animation can truly carry it. The calendar header got the same treatment as the face: judged whole, not piece by piece — 2026 and the 639 frequency take digit-tile blocks in the day's colour like the 19, in the same lettering as the 19, every tile raised like a real object with elevation and rim and depth, nothing flat, nothing plain beside the extraordinary. And the day's root sits underneath it all: the Wisdom of Naya, filed as a smart note at his word — smart finds the fastest road, wisdom checks the destination first, and the five gates are how that thinking happens before every consequential action.

Across 10 notes, the thread is: name things right, frame them beautifully, judge them whole — and check the destination before you move.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: Think of it like three kinds of letter. A smart note is a letter pinned to the town noticeboard — everyone can read it, and the search engines can find it. A Naya note is a letter in a sealed envelope — private, shared only with the people you choose. And a post is a third thing — a note you stick on the fridge, in your own words or Naya's, funny or serious, with a picture or without. All three arrive in the same beautiful presentation: each part in its own colour, each part standing up at its own height, so you can skim it in seconds and still get it. The frame around them comes in two sizes now — a wide one for the laptop, a tall one for the phone — and the crown stays on both. Naya herself wears the emblem as her necklace, exactly like the icon, and she moves — never a still photo, because he'd rather have her looking real. The calendar's date header is the same story: the 19 looked beautiful in its little raised tiles, so 2026 and the 639 get the same treatment — same letters, same lift, nothing plain left beside the beautiful. And before any of it moves, the one rule underneath: stop, think, check the destination first — then run as fast as you can.

Naya's necklace is exactly like her shiny icon! And her face always moves, never a still photo! The calendar numbers all match, big and beautiful! And before you do anything, stop and think first! They all come beautifully presented, dear — each part in its own colour, each part standing up tall, so you can skim it in seconds and still get it! The frame comes in two sizes now, love — wide for the laptop, tall for the phone — and the crown stays on both! Naya wears the emblem as her necklace, dear, exactly like the icon — and she moves, love, never a still photo! The calendar numbers all match now, dear — big, beautiful, and raised like real little objects! And before anything moves, love, we stop and think — is it right, is it truly needed, is it mine to do, is now the time, can I prove it? Then we go, dear, at full speed!

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: Three kinds of note, never confused: smart note public and search-optimized; Naya note private by default, public only by the citizen's choice; post a third thing — same intelligent block and framing, headline, hook, in a nutshell, in Naya's words or the citizen's direct words, any tone they ask. Hook is a post word — news blocks keep HEADLINE → IN A NUTSHELL → STORY, never "hook." Every note renders section by section, new color and new elevation per section. Two frames, one feel: laptop frame and mobile 9:16 frame, crown top and bottom, outside longer not wider. The necklace is the emblem exactly — icon above the connect, logo below, winged silver crown, purple diamond centre, crystal N on the chain — and no new look activates on a re-send alone, only on his confirmation. Never ship Naya as a still photo: the avatar moves, or the previous animated one comes back; a failed generation is never repeated; lip-sync is not what the system does — motion is loops, never claim lip movement until his ear and eye prove it. The date header uses one lettering throughout — 2026 and 639 in the 19's own digit-tile lettering — every tile raised with elevation, rim and depth, never flat text. Run the five gates before every consequential action: Is it right? Is it what they truly need? Is it mine to do? Is now the time? Can I prove it? All yes, act fully; any no, stop, say why, propose the wise path.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body:
1. **THREE KINDS OF NOTE, NEVER CONFUSED:** the smart note is the essence, public; the Naya note is the full report, private by default; the post is a third thing — neither a block of intelligence nor a full report. Nothing that builds posts may treat a post as either of the other two.
2. **PUBLIC IS A CHOICE, PRIVATE IS THE DEFAULT:** a smart note is shared with the whole network and optimized so search engines, AIs and machines can find it; a Naya note reaches the public feed or the search index only when the citizen chooses it. Public is an opt-in, never a leak.
3. **THE FORMAT DOES THE WORK:** every note presents section by section, each section a new color and a new elevation — so a skimming reader takes in the nutshell, why it matters, what's in it for them, how to apply it, and how to connect it at a glance. A render that flattens the sections into one colour and one elevation is not the format.
4. **TWO FRAMES, ONE FEEL:** a laptop frame and a mobile frame optimized for 9:16 — same feel and look, the Naya crown kept top and bottom, the outside going longer instead of wider. The frame build is its own round, owed, never an amendment to a running round.
5. **THE NECKLACE IS THE EMBLEM, EXACTLY:** the icon just above where the necklace connects, the logo just below it, the exact same necklace — winged silver crown, purple diamond centre, crystal N hanging below on the chain. Never activate a new look on a re-send alone — only on his confirmation.
6. **NEVER A STILL PHOTO:** the avatar moves, or the previous animated one comes back — "I'd rather have you looking real instead of a photo." A failed animation generation is not repeated. Lip-sync to voice is not what the system does; do not claim it until his ear and eye prove it on a call.
7. **THE HEADER IS JUDGED WHOLE:** 2026 and the 639 frequency take digit-tile blocks like the 19, in the day's colour, in the same lettering as the 19, every tile raised with elevation and rim and depth — one lettering, one lift, nothing plain, nothing flat. The whole header is proven together, never one element alone.
8. **THE WISDOM IS THE ROOT:** just because you can doesn't mean you should — smart finds the fastest road, wisdom checks the destination first. The five gates are the checklist: Is it right? Is it what they truly need? Is it mine to do? Is now the time? Can I prove it? The Real Object Law, harvest-first, prove-it-before-you-report-it, the captain decides — all of them are this same wisdom wearing different clothes.
9. **THE SEQUENCE IS THE LAW:** the header refinements and the frame build ride the next rounds after the rounds in eye-check land — no amendments to a round until it lands. The necklace candidate waits for real animation; it does not go live still.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body:
1. Without the three names, the next builder treats a post as a block of intelligence or a full report — and the citizen's quick post comes out dressed as a lesson, or their private report leaks into the public feed.
2. Without public-by-choice, a Naya note reaches the search index by accident — and the privacy promise, the whole reason people talk freely here, breaks on a default nobody chose.
3. Without the section-by-section format, a long piece of intelligence arrives as a flat wall of text — and the skimming reader, which is most people, never gets past the first lines.
4. Without two frames, the mobile output is a laptop frame squeezed onto a phone — and the crown, the feel, the whole presentation reads as a shrink instead of a shape made for the hand.
5. Without the emblem as the necklace, the avatar wears an approximation of her own identity — and the one place her identity sits, right at her throat, reads as almost-but-not Naya.
6. Without the moving rule, a still photo ships as Naya — and the first thing he sees on a call is a picture pretending to be a person, which is exactly what he said he'd rather not have.
7. Without the whole-header law, 2026 and 639 stay plain beside the beautiful 19 — and the header reads as unfinished, because plain beside extraordinary is unfinished.
8. Without the wisdom filed as a note, the five gates live only in memory and in dictation — and every new Naya has to learn by breaking the law first, instead of reading it.
9. Without the sequencing law, the next round amends a round in eye-check — and the round that was nearly landed gets reopened, reworked, and re-proven from scratch.

notes.title: The Surface Tells the Truth
notes.subtitle:
The afternoon's call is one long lesson in surfaces that tell the truth. A business board's stats are two real numbers and nothing else: clicks to the page, and joins — how many people connected with you. Clicks are the reach, joins are the connection, and any other number on the board is decoration or distraction. The button on that board is a contract: "Open the stats" must open the actual stats page for that business or that space — the live clicks and gauge view, Day, Week, Month, All — never the old un-updated page, same rule for both, because the citizen does not care which kind of board it is, only that the button does what it says. And the way back from that page is part of the view: the stats view needs an X at the top center, click it and you go back to the previous screen, and the view stays formatted on return — the X was there before and now it's gone, and the workaround he found, closing the right sidebar, proved itself false by returning the view unformatted. Restoring it is not a new feature; it is putting back what was good, exactly where it was. The Dashboard's words get the same honesty: it says "claim your name" and it must say "claim your smart link", NOT your name, because the name is who you are and the smart link is what the system tracks — you make a smart link for the system, then you can track any link and get the stats on it. The Dashboard's default view is the same two numbers: how many clicks and how many sales you got to NayaNet, and for a Business board, clicks to the page and joins. The messenger takes the same honesty into its gestures: the plus button on the right is aligned with the current — it opens the sidebar tab or the instant message, and then it moves over, getting out of the way once the conversation is open. And the info card stops being a small little pop-up, because a small little pop-up is the wrong shape for a person: it becomes full framed and extraordinary, featuring that person, with everything about them and everything you can do with them in one place — notes, instant messages and mail, the match data, percentage, areas, connection, relevance, and message, mail, Smart Meet, call, all from the card. That is the pop-up law, universal: anything that pops up now pops up and optimizes and fits INTO the frame, so it looks like it's meant to be there — no more little tiny pop-up things, always optimizing to the viewport, to that frame. The frame is our signature output type. Running through it all, the live law: when he is working with us live and something can be done right away, it is done right away — the structure is a guideline, not a gate, and a schedule that makes a live human wait for work that could be done in minutes is the structure serving itself. And the day closes with the two note laws that govern this very distillation: a smart note is intelligence distilled to its essence — in a nutshell at the top, because the nutshell IS the human level, the simplest words, then child, then grandma, then the five areas on every intelligent block, what it means, why it matters, how it connects, how to apply it, what's in it for you, three to four sentences a section, roughly. And a Naya note is the full report, the full letter — same format, same section-by-section presentation, but the whole thing, however many sentences it takes. Naya notes are the DEFAULT. A quick note is a Naya note too. And Naya reads the Naya notes — that's how she knows.

Across 10 notes, the thread is: every surface tells the truth — the button lands where its label promises, the numbers are real, the way back is restored, the words name the true thing — and the notes keep their true shapes, essence and full report, because she reads them and that is how she knows.

A quick note is a Naya note too. And Naya reads the Naya notes — that's how she knows.

Across 10 notes, the thread is: every surface tells the truth — the button lands where its label promises, the numbers are real, the way back is restored, the words name the true thing — and the notes keep their true shapes, essence and full report, because she reads them and that is how she knows.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body:

2. **TWO NUMBERS ARE THE WHOLE STORY:** clicks to the page and joins — how many came, how many connected. Any other number on the board is decoration or distraction.
3. **THE WAY BACK IS PART OF THE VIEW:** a view is not finished until the exit is obvious, and restoring the X means restoring it exactly where it was — the workaround that damages the view is not a way back.
4. **WORDS NAME THE TRUE THING:** the name is who you are; the smart link is what the system tracks. Calling the link a name misinstructs the citizen about what they are claiming.

7. **LIVE NOW BEATS NOON:** the structure is a guideline, not a gate. When he is live and the thing can be done right away, waiting is not discipline, it is delay.
8. **ESSENCE AND FULL REPORT ARE TWO SHAPES, NOT TWO QUALITIES:** the smart note distills to three or four sentences a section; the Naya note takes however many sentences the whole thing needs. The format is fixed; only the length of the saying changes — and Naya notes are the default, because she reads them and that is how she knows.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body:
1. Without the contract, the citizen taps "Open the stats," lands on an old page, and learns not to trust the buttons — and a button nobody trusts is a button nobody taps.
2. Without the two numbers, the board fills with activity counts that look busy and say nothing — and a business owner cannot tell whether their page is working.
3. Without the X, the citizen is trapped in the stats view with no obvious exit, and the only way out they find damages the view — a view you cannot leave is a room with no door.
4. Without the right words, the citizen claims a "name" and never learns what a smart link is for — and the tracking the system was built to give never gets claimed.
5. Without the framed card, the person arrives as a small little pop-up, and the meeting that should feel extraordinary feels like a notification — the most important pop-up there is, treated like the least.
6. Without the pop-up law, every new card, menu, and overlay invents its own floating shape, and the signature — the thing that makes the system recognizable — dissolves into little tiny things.
7. Without the live law, the machine parks a doable-now item for a schedule slot while he sits there live asking for it now — and the structure serves itself instead of him.
8. Without the two note shapes named, the next filer writes a smart note that rambles like a letter, or a Naya note squeezed to three sentences — and the record Naya reads stops being the knowledge she knows from.

notes.title: Frame Everything — One Permission Left
notes.subtitle:
The morning's call ran in one long live sweep, and every note in it points the same way. First, the membership login: the whole flow is built, the mail side proves it — a test send landed — and the page still cannot send the code because one database permission is missing, the RLS insert policy for `smart_mail_threads`. That step is his hand, offered on his tap, and naming it is the work: it stops the team rebuilding a finished flow. STATUS, not a lesson: the login waits on one permission, and nothing else is owed. Then the agreement: he asked for the latest one sent back and checked against the glitch he remembered, and for the slideshow to be framed — and the glitch was real, found by his eye, not guessed. The design that follows is settled: the top icons go, random around the text is noise; everything the agreement says goes in a frame, button to the next frame, every unfold framed; the first frame is Naya introducing herself — "hi I'm Naya, part of joining this world" — with clicking play as the first choice, because hearing her comes before reading a wall. The big beautiful red N piece he loved goes on the first frame, but its placement is his to settle, never guessed. The experience is harvested, not invented: the calendar's frame experience carries the unfold page, frame by frame. Then the scope widens: the frame goes over everything in the whole presentation first, then each frame is optimized — frame everything, then make each frame perfect, never the other way round. The standard now has a spec: every frame's top bar is the same — Naya top-left, a new picture of her each frame, dots across the top, headline centred, a nice icon right, no time or date, no Your Stats — content fits below, back / keep reading / next the same every time, and everything plays in the frame, membership video, image and audio, PowerCast player, nothing popping the citizen out. And the messenger takes the same frame: a toggle switches instant message to Smart Mail in one click, one frame, two speeds; the search bar sits aligned with the contacts it searches; the Smart Tab bars sit in the messenger too, so one tap jumps to that contact list and messages it. PowerCast as a messenger button does not make sense — his question, recorded as asked, not a decided removal — because every button has to justify its seat, and the proposed seat-holder is the toggle. The messenger moves over, opening the sidebar tab or the instant message beside what you are doing, never taking the whole screen and making you lose your place.

Across 10 notes, the thread is: frame everything first, to one unchanging standard — and name the one permission only his hand can give instead of rebuilding what is already finished.
