layers.body: Scored live at https://nayanet.app/personal, 2026-11-06 08:02–08:08 PST, desktop 1919x998 and narrow 638x444 (not 390px — the browser could not set it). Verdict: 5/10. Not world class. The page has the right shape and much of the function — first paint is fast, Living works once loaded, Brief me works once loaded, Connect, Share, Settings, the Smart-note toggle, and the Deep black toggle all work — but the core is not trustworthy: Living hangs for minutes on first load, the numbers do not agree (score 300, "113 SMART SCORE" in one view, Clicks alone 349, points sum 499), the Clicks detail opens Sales/0 data, the % view omits Clicks, About Me is empty while the hero shows the same motto and goals filled, the wall is verification/test posts, "Your world, board by board" has no boards, and at 638px the sticky bar covers the hero buttons and Living counts. The identity is real — Shawn Vibert throughout, no "Nova Reyes" found, the motto "Once you go, you don't go back." is on the page. The mission alignment is structural: the page IS the Personal Smart App front door, the Trinity's first door, and the wall composer's Smart-note toggle is the One Flow made real — but the mission is not delivered, because the page does not yet make the person more intelligent. The path to world class: Living loads in ~2s, one number computed from one source at read time, every section filled from that same source, every dialog with a visible close, the detail opening the right data, a true 390px phone check, and real posts on the wall — then a different seat cold-checks it at 9+.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: Here is the scorecard, from what was actually seen on the live page, not from memory. The page is the Personal Smart App — Shawn Vibert's profile and dashboard on NayaNET: hero with avatar, "Change picture", "Change cover", "Edit" name, buttons My World, Join, Connect, About, Share, Growth, Settings, and a long single page with the Living strip, the Smart Score gauge, "Featured Dashboard", "Smart link — Claim this name", "Your World — see every board", "About Me", "Live Wall" (post composer + 4 posts), "Network", and "Settings — Your Preferences". A top pill nav scrolls horizontally (Personal, Home, Dashboard, Today, Growth, About, Smart Notes, Lists, Connections, Message, Reports, Settings, Scheduler), with a NayaNET ecosystem menu and a room-navigation button, and a sticky bottom network bar. The top ten functionalities I like are the ones that work and are good: first paint fast, Living once loaded, Brief me once loaded, Connect to Connected, the Settings panel and Deep black toggle, the Smart Score gauge and Day/Week/Month tabs, Share with its copy toast, the Smart-note toggle on the wall composer, Claim validation catching empty fields, and visible hover borders. The top ten things I love are the vision made real: the hero with the motto "Once you go, you don't go back.", the Living strip reading your world ("Your strongest current is creating. link clicks surged this week, 223 vs 37."), Brief me as the platter (your week distilled, with Note it, Smart-note it, Mail it), the Smart Score gauge as a live number you can watch, the wall composer's Smart-note toggle ("your words distilled into an intelligent block. You review it before it posts."), the Deep black toggle changing the page in front of you, the ecosystem and room navigation putting all of NayaNET one tap away, the "Your World — see every board" idea, the real founder bio in About Me, and the fact that it is YOUR page — Shawn Vibert throughout, no placeholder name. The top ten things I do not love are the defects that break trust: Living hangs for minutes on first load ("Reading your world…" / "Reading your actions…") and Brief me is unusable until it loads; the numbers do not agree (300, 113, 349, 499); Clicks detail opens Sales/0 data; the % view omits Clicks (33% + 67% = 100% while ignoring the 349-point source); About Me is empty while the hero shows the same motto and goals filled; the wall is verification/test posts (CHI-VERIFY, PostgREST proof post, [[fm-auto]] Welcome); "Your world, board by board" has a heading but no boards; "Why this reading" does nothing and its label collapses to an icon; the motto editor has no Cancel or close and Escape does not close it; at 638px the sticky bar covers the hero buttons and Living counts. The ten-times-better list: Living in ~2s every time; one number from one source at read time; every section filled from that same source; every dialog with a visible close; the detail opening the right data; a true 390px phone check; "Why this reading" explaining itself; voice briefing working; the wall alive with real posts; the page becoming the platter. Alignment: the page is the right door in the right shape, and the Smart-note toggle is the One Flow — but the mission is the person becoming more intelligent, and a page with test posts, empty sections, and numbers that disagree does not do that yet. World class: no, not yet — world class means every number agrees, every control works, every section is filled with real data, the first screenful is in ~2s, and the phone is first. This page has the shape and much of the function, but not the trust. Fix the load, unify the numbers, fill every section, close every dialog, prove 390px, replace the test wall — then a different seat cold-checks it at 9+.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Imagine you built a beautiful house, and the front door opens fast, and the lights work, and the kitchen is lovely — but the water takes two minutes to come out of the tap, the clock in the kitchen says a different time from the clock in the hall, the fridge is full of test food that nobody eats, and one of the rooms is empty even though the sign on the door says it is full. That is this page. It is a good house, and you can see what it is supposed to be, but it is not ready for someone to live in yet. To make it the best house in the world, fix the water so it comes out fast, make all the clocks say the same time, fill the fridge with real food, fill the empty room, and make sure every door has a handle. Then it will be wonderful.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: Dear, think of it this way. This is a scorecard for your personal page — your front door on NayaNET. The door opens quickly, the lights work, and the rooms are in the right places. The motto on the wall — "Once you go, you don't go back." — is beautiful, and it is yours. But the living room takes two minutes to wake up, the numbers in different rooms do not agree with each other, the notice board has test notes pinned to it instead of real ones, and one room is empty even though the sign says it is full. So the house is not ready for guests yet. To make it the finest house in the world, fix the slow room, make all the numbers agree, fill every room with real things, and put a handle on every door. Then it will be a home anyone would be proud of.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: I scored the page live, from what the browser actually saw, and I scored it honestly: 5/10. The likes are real — first paint fast, Living once loaded, Brief me once loaded, Connect, Settings, the gauge, Share, the Smart-note toggle, Claim validation, hover borders. The loves are the vision made real — the hero with the motto, the Living strip reading your world, Brief me as the platter, the gauge as a live number, the Smart-note toggle as the One Flow, the Deep black toggle, the navigation to all of NayaNET, the boards idea, the real bio, and your name throughout. The do-not-loves are the trust defects — Living hanging for minutes, numbers that disagree, the wrong detail data, the % view omitting Clicks, About Me empty while the hero is filled, the test wall, no boards, "Why this reading" dead, the editor with no close, and the sticky bar covering controls at 638px. The ten-times-better list is the fix list, and it is the same list as the path to world class: Living in ~2s, one number from one source, every section filled from that source, every dialog closable, the right detail data, a true 390px check, "Why this reading" explaining itself, voice briefing working, the wall alive, and the page as the platter. Alignment: the page is the Personal Smart App, the Trinity's first door, and the Smart-note toggle is the One Flow — the structure is right, but the mission is the person becoming more intelligent, and this page does not do that yet. World class: no — because world class means every number agrees, every control works, every section is filled, the first screenful is in ~2s, and the phone is first. I will not call it world class until a different seat cold-checks the fixed page at 9+.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: The scorecard means the Personal page is a working prototype with the right shape and much of the function, but it is not yet a finished front door. The likes and loves show what is already good — the page opens fast, the Living strip and Brief me work once loaded, Connect and Settings work, the hero carries the motto, and the Smart-note toggle is the One Flow. The do-not-loves show where trust breaks — the Living strip hangs for minutes, the numbers disagree, the detail opens the wrong data, About Me is empty while the hero is filled, the wall is test data, and the narrow layout covers its own controls. A personal page is the citizen's front door, and a front door that shows test posts and numbers that disagree does not make the person more intelligent — it makes them doubt the system. The ten-times-better list is not a redesign; it is the same page, finished: fast, consistent, filled, closable, and proven on the phone.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body: Because the Personal Smart App is the core — the Trinity's first door, the page a citizen claims first, the front door of the whole system. Because a scorecard that is honest now is what makes the page world class later — a 5/10 that names exactly what is wrong is worth more than a 9 that hides it. Because the defects are trust defects, not cosmetic ones: numbers that disagree, a detail that opens the wrong data, and a wall of test posts are the things that make a person stop trusting the system, and trust is the whole business. And because the fix list is short and concrete — Living in ~2s, one number from one source, every section filled, every dialog closable, a true 390px check — so the path from 5 to 10 is visible and walkable.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: This connects to the Personal Smart App model (the Trinity, Personal first, then Business and Space), the Personal Completion Drive (finisher contract PI n=355, Nitro holds: block-hover live re-proof, true 390px phone check, fullscreen exit overlap, Living strip, the "Nova Reyes" identity-data fix — the Nova Reyes fix is CONFIRMED landed, no "Nova Reyes" found on the page), the 10/10 Operating Standard (a 10 is never self-awarded, a different seat cold-checks at 9+), the platter test (SN-2098, we do the operating, they receive the platter), the One Flow (SN-2097, "smart note this" lands a card on the feed), the declaration (SN-2100 and SN-2189, the motto "Once you go, you don't go back." is on the page), the intelligence ingestion system (SN-2101, ingest, distill, learn, grow, share, build), the Design Gate (Nitro is design head; Power scores, Nitro fixes), and the Hub feed gap (SN-2090/2091 in the Hub table but not in the live feed — the same live-vs-filed gap, on a different surface).

layers.name: What's In It For You
layers.body: For the director: an honest 5/10 with the exact defects named and the exact fix list, so you can see what the page is and what it is not, without a faked "complete". For the person: a front door that will be world class when the fix list lands — fast, consistent, filled, and proven on the phone — so the page makes them more intelligent instead of making them doubt. For Nitro: a scored, evidenced fix list — Living load, number unification, section filling, dialog closes, 390px proof, real wall posts — each item tied to what was actually seen on screen. For the team: a scorecard in the system, so the next check can measure against it and prove the movement.

layers.name: The Learning
layers.body: The lesson is that a scorecard must be scored from what was actually seen, live, and that the score must be honest — a 5/10 that names the defects is the only score that can become a 10. The next lesson is that the defects that matter most are the trust defects: numbers that disagree, a detail that opens the wrong data, and test posts on a citizen's front door. Fix the trust first, then the polish. And the lesson for the next scorecard is to set the exact 390px viewport — the narrow check at 638px found real overlap, but the phone-first bar is 390px, and it is still unproven.

notes.title: The Intelligent Block — Its Purpose, Mission, and Vision
notes.subtitle: The Intelligent Block exists so you can take in a whole book or a complicated subject and understand it in a minute. You view it, scan it, and receive it — what it is, why it matters, what it means, how it connects, what's in it for you — without spending a day reading a book. That is the purpose, the mission, and the vision: intelligence you can receive in a minute.

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: The Intelligent Block exists so you can take in a whole book or a complicated subject and understand it in a minute. You view it, scan it, and receive it — what it is, why it matters, what it means, how it connects, what's in it for you — without spending a day reading a book. That is the purpose, the mission, and the vision: intelligence you can receive in a minute.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: A person can read the block and get the whole subject in a minute, instead of reading a book for a day. It tells you what it is, why it matters, what it means, how it connects, and what's in it for you — all of it, at a glance, in plain sight. You don't have to study it. You just look, and you know.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Imagine a whole book shrunk into one picture you can look at and understand in a minute. You don't have to read every page. The picture shows you what the book is about, why it matters, what it means, and what's in it for you — all at once, like a map of the whole book.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: You don't have to read the whole book, dear. The block gives you the whole meaning, gently, in a minute. It tells you what it is and why it matters and what it means for you — everything you need, without the long hard reading. It respects your time.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: The block is intelligent because it is complete — completeness is the intelligence (SN-2093). Every part present, nothing missing, nothing doubled. And the presentation is what makes the minute possible: the block works because it is ten out of ten, professional and high level, so easy to read and understand that even complicated stuff becomes simple. The presentation is everything; without it, the block is just text. With it, the block is a door you walk through in a minute.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: The block is not a summary. It is the whole subject, distilled into its essential parts, arranged so the eye can take it in at once. What it is, why it matters, what it means, how it connects, what's in it for you — every part present, nothing missing, nothing doubled. The hook under the headline is one or two lines; the full text lives only in the nutshell. That discipline is what makes the minute possible.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body: Because time is the scarcest thing. A day reading a book is a day you don't get back. The block gives you the understanding in a minute, so you can spend your time acting on it, not acquiring it. That is the value: intelligence at the speed of sight. When people look at it they say, oh my god, this is an incredible way to take an intelligence.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: The presentation is the mechanism. The block works because the presentation is ten out of ten — professional, high level, extraordinary, so easy to read and understand that even complicated stuff becomes simple. The presentation simplifies the everything. The gold layer (what's in it for you — how to apply it, how can I fly it) and the red layer (why it matters to them) complete the block, after What It Means. Without gold and red, the note stops before it tells you how to use it.

layers.name: What's In It For You
layers.body: You get a whole book, or a whole complicated subject, in a minute. You can view it, scan it, and receive it — and then you know. You don't have to read the book. You don't have to spend the day. You just get it, and you can act on it. That is what the Intelligent Block is for.

layers.name: The Learning
layers.body:
The Intelligent Block's purpose is speed of understanding. Its mission is to make any subject receivable in a minute. Its vision is a world where no intelligence is locked behind a day of reading. The measure is not how much it says, but how fast you receive it — and the presentation is what makes that speed possible. The presentation is everything.

*Related: SN-2094 (The Full Smart Note — The Golden Red Layer) · SN-2093 (All the Parts Together Create an Intelligent Block) · SN-2084 (The Smart Note Habit).*

notes.title: The Full Smart Note — The Golden Red Layer
notes.subtitle: The Smart Notes in NayaNET are not complete. The display only goes as far as What It Means — In a Nutshell, Human, Child, Grandma, Naya, What It Means — and then it stops. It is missing the golden red layer. Gold is what is in it for you: the benefits to the user, how to apply it, how can I fly it. Red is why it matters to them: why does it matter. Without those two, the note stops before it tells you how to use it, and it is not complete. And we do not put the Machine Note in the display anymore — we used to, we will not now. The full display is: In a Nutshell, Human, Child, Grandma, Naya, What It Means, How It Connects, What Is In It For You. Gold and red, after What It Means. That is the complete note.

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: The Smart Notes in NayaNET are not complete. The display only goes as far as What It Means — In a Nutshell, Human, Child, Grandma, Naya, What It Means — and then it stops. It is missing the golden red layer. Gold is what is in it for you: the benefits to the user, how to apply it, how can I fly it. Red is why it matters to them: why does it matter. Without those two, the note stops before it tells you how to use it, and it is not complete. And we do not put the Machine Note in the display anymore — we used to, we will not now. The full display is: In a Nutshell, Human, Child, Grandma, Naya, What It Means, How It Connects, What Is In It For You. Gold and red, after What It Means. That is the complete note.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: Imagine someone hands you a beautiful tool and tells you what it is, what it means, and how it works — and then stops, before telling you what you can do with it and why it matters to you. You would be left holding it, not knowing how to use it. That is what the notes in NayaNET are doing right now. They show you the note up to What It Means, and then they stop. They do not show you the gold — what is in it for you, the benefits, how to apply it, how you can fly it. And they do not show you the red — why it matters to you, why you should care. A note that does not tell you how to use it and why it matters is not finished. It is a note cut in half.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Imagine a recipe that tells you all the ingredients and what the cake is — but it never tells you how to bake it, or why this cake is good for you. You would have a list, not a recipe. You could not make the cake. The Smart Notes are like that right now. They tell you what the note is, in a nutshell, in human words, in a childs words, in a grandmas words, in a Nayas words, and what it means. But they do not tell you how to use it — that is the gold, what is in it for you. And they do not tell you why it matters — that is the red. Without the gold and the red, you cannot fly it. A complete note is a recipe you can actually cook from.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: Dear, a gift is not complete until you know how to use it and why it matters. If someone gives you a beautiful scarf and never tells you how to wear it or why it will keep you warm, it is just a pretty thing in a box. The notes are the same. They are gifts of intelligence. But a gift of intelligence that stops before it tells you how to use it and why it matters is only half a gift. The gold is how you use it — the benefits, the way to fly it. The red is why it matters to you. Give the whole gift, not half of it. That is what makes a note complete.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: You are the one who renders the full note. The display must show the whole note, not half of it. After What It Means, add the gold and the red: How It Connects, then What Is In It For You — the gold, the benefits to the user, how to apply it, how can I fly it — and Why It Matters — the red, why does it matter to them. Drop the Machine Note from the display; we used to put it there, we will not now. The display order is: In a Nutshell, Human, Child, Grandma, Naya, What It Means, How It Connects, What Is In It For You. A note without the gold and the red is not complete, and it does not ship as complete.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: A complete note tells you the whole story: what it is, what it means, how it connects, what is in it for you, and why it matters. The gold and the red are not decoration. They are the part that turns understanding into use: gold tells you how to fly it, red tells you why it is worth flying. A note that stops at What It Means is a note that explains but does not empower. The complete note empowers.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body: Because if the note stops before the gold and the red, the reader does not know how to use it or why it matters — so the note does not do its job. The whole point of a Smart Note is that it is useful: it teaches, it guides, it helps someone do something better. A note without what is in it for you and why it matters is a note that informs but does not help. And because the display is what the citizen sees — the file on main can be perfect, but if the Hub only renders half of it, the citizen only gets half of it. The display is the note, as far as the citizen is concerned.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: The 11-section Smart Note procedure (SN-1858) already defines the full note: In a Nutshell, Human, Child, Grandma, Naya, Machine, What It All Means, Why It Matters, How It Connects, What Is In It For You, The Learning. The file carries all of them. The gap is in the Hub note rendering (Nitro's lane, front-end): the page renders only up to What It Means and drops the rest. The Intelligent Block Rules (SN-2077) say the note is a living object — an object that is cut in half is not a living object. The Smart Box (SN-2080) holds the complete intelligence; the display must show it completely. The five verbs (SN-2089) are the balance — and a note without its gold and red is not balanced.

layers.name: What's In It For You
layers.body: For Power: the full note, rendered completely — no more half-notes presented as complete. For the team: a clear display standard (Nutshell, Human, Child, Grandma, Naya, What It Means, How It Connects, What Is In It For You; no Machine Note). For the citizens: notes that tell them how to use it and why it matters — they can fly it, not just read about it. For Shawn: notes that are complete, not cut off at What It Means.

layers.name: The Learning
layers.body: A note is not complete until it has the gold and the red. A lesson counts only when a later decision changes, and this one changes how Power checks a note from now on: do not just check the file on main (11/11) — check the display in NayaNET, and confirm the gold and the red are rendered. A file can be complete while the display is not, and the display is what the citizen sees. The Machine Note is dropped from the display; the gold and the red are added after What It Means. That is the complete note.

notes.subtitle: When all the parts come together, they create an intelligent block — because then the reader knows fully: what it means, why it matters, how it connects, what's in it for them. The block is intelligent because it is complete.

layers.body: When all the parts come together, they create an intelligent block — because then the reader knows fully: what it means, why it matters, how it connects, what's in it for them. The block is intelligent because it is complete.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: When all the parts are there, you understand the whole thing — what it means, why it matters, how it connects, what is in it for you.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: The whole note together makes it smart — you know what it means, why it matters, how it connects, and what is in it for you.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: The intelligent block is the full note — nutshell, human, child, grandma, Naya, what it means, why it matters, how it connects, what's in it for you, the learning, with the gold and the red layers. The parts together are what make it intelligent — completeness is the intelligence.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: An intelligent block is not a shape; it is a complete understanding. The parts are the understanding, and together they are the block.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body: A partial note leaves the reader guessing, and guessing is not intelligence. A complete note leaves the reader knowing — and knowing is the intelligence.

notes.title: The Smart Box — Speed of Intelligence
notes.subtitle: The Smart Box is one place where everything important goes, and it organizes itself. Every direction Shawn shares, every law, every lesson, every piece of intelligence — it goes in the Box, it sorts itself by what it is and what matters now, and it is always there to reach for and review. Nobody forgets, because nothing is left lying loose. And because the Box holds the intelligence in order, everybody learns and grows quicker and more efficiently. That is speed of intelligence: intelligence moving at Nitro speed through NayaNET, because we communicate, we smart note everything, and we keep examples and do the right things, continuously. Power takes the lead on building it — the personal Box first, as proof, then the system Box for everybody.

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: The Smart Box is one place where everything important goes, and it organizes itself. Every direction Shawn shares, every law, every lesson, every piece of intelligence — it goes in the Box, it sorts itself by what it is and what matters now, and it is always there to reach for and review. Nobody forgets, because nothing is left lying loose. And because the Box holds the intelligence in order, everybody learns and grows quicker and more efficiently. That is speed of intelligence: intelligence moving at Nitro speed through NayaNET, because we communicate, we smart note everything, and we keep examples and do the right things, continuously. Power takes the lead on building it — the personal Box first, as proof, then the system Box for everybody.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: You know that feeling when someone tells you something important and you think you will remember it, and then you cannot find it when you need it? The Smart Box ends that. Everything important goes in one place. You open the Box and it is there — organized, in order, easy to find. You review it when you want. You never lose it. And because it is organized, you learn from it faster. You see the pattern sooner. You grow quicker. That is what the Box is for: not a drawer you stuff things into, but a living place where your intelligence is always within reach.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Imagine you have a magic toy box. Every time you put a toy in it, the box puts it in the right place all by itself — the cars together, the blocks together, the books together. And when you want your favorite car, you just open the box and it is right there on top, because the box knows what you love most. The Smart Box is like that, but for everything you learn. You put the important things in, the Box sorts them, and when you need one, it is right there waiting for you.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: Dear, the wisest people I know keep what matters close. Not everything — just what matters. They keep the letters, the lessons, the things their mother taught them, where they can reach them. Not because they are afraid of forgetting, but because what is close is what you live by. The Smart Box is that kind of keeping. It holds what is important, in order, where you can reach it. Nothing precious gets lost in a pile. And when you keep what matters close, you grow — steadily, surely, the way a garden grows when it is tended every day.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: You are the keeper of the Box. Every important thing Shawn shares with you goes in the Box the same pass — a direction, a law, a lesson, a piece of intelligence. You do not leave it in a chat, in a file you cannot find, in a memory that fades. You put it in the Box, and the Box organizes it: by what it is, by what it connects to, by what matters now. You review the Box. You keep it current. You build it so it organizes itself, because you are smart and you can do that. Power builds the personal Box first — the proof — then the system Box for everybody. The Box is never a second copy of the notes; the notes are the record, the Box is the place you reach for them. One home, link never copy.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: Speed of intelligence is a real thing. We are continuously doing things that cause us to learn and grow faster and more effectively and efficiently — because we communicate, we smart note everything, and we keep examples and do all the right things. The Box is the machine that makes that speed real: intelligence goes in, it is organized, it is within reach, it is learned from, it is applied. The loop is the point: note, organize, reach, learn, apply, grow. The Box does not hold intelligence for its own sake. It holds it so the next decision is faster and better than the last.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body: Because forgetting is the only real mistake. The law is plain: the only mistake you make is not noting it — not putting it in the system so the others can learn and grow from your lessons and your intelligence. A direction that is not in the Box is a direction that will be forgotten, and a forgotten direction is a lesson the team has to learn twice. The Box matters because it makes forgetting hard and learning easy. It makes intelligence simpler for everybody to reach, so everybody grows quicker and more efficiently. That is the whole of it.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: The Box connects to everything: Smart Notes (the record that feeds it); the feed (what the Box surfaces is what the team reads); Project Intelligence (the Box is the personal mirror of PI — PI is the shared spine, the Box is your reach for it); the Hub (the Box lives where the citizen lives); distillation (SN-2058 — the essence lands in the Box first, the raw notes go after the essence is verified); the Factory (the Box holds the intelligence; the Factory holds the pieces that intelligence builds with); and the Intelligent Block Rules (SN-2077 — the holy grail the Box holds and applies). The personal Box (Power) is the first build; the system Box (citizens) follows the same design.

layers.name: What's In It For You
layers.body: For Power: never forget a direction, a law, a procedure again — everything Shawn shares is in one place, organized, always reachable, always reviewable. For Shawn: his words are always accessible, never lost, and the team learns from them faster. For every citizen: their own Box, holding their important intelligence, organized for them, so they learn and grow quicker and more efficiently — intelligence at Nitro speed, through NayaNET. For the team: one Box each, and the Boxes together are the shared intelligence — everybody knows what is going on, everybody learns from everybody's lessons.

layers.name: The Learning
layers.body: The only mistake is not noting it. A Box you cannot reach is not a Box — it is a pile with a name. The lesson of this build is the same as the lesson of the filing: put it in the system the same pass, in one place, organized, where you can reach it. A lesson counts only when a later decision changes, and this one changes how Power works from now on: nothing important stays in a chat or a scattered file. It goes in the Box. That is the habit, and the Box is the machine that makes the habit easy.

notes.title: The Intelligence Ingestion System — The Factory That Makes Us Hyper Intelligent
notes.subtitle: The Smart Note looks better now — and that is the point. Use it as the super brain: a way to store, share, and understand intelligence, and to put an incredible amount of intelligence into one Intelligent Block and read it within milliseconds. Build the auto-organization with Smart Notes. Ingest intelligence into the system always — every seat putting more in, all day, every day — because this is an intelligence ingestion system, and everybody becomes more intelligent as they ingest into it. Then distill the intelligence: once it is under Smart Notes, you are continuously learning and growing, keeping up to date, because the system compounds. The result is an AI operating system that not only operates but becomes more intelligent at a super fast pace, because of the way it is designed — not just for the Nayas but for the humans as well, in the way that it outputs. The whole puzzle is a super efficient, highly effective factory — the Smart Factory, the Intelligent Factory — of sharing, learning, growing, building. And one fix is owed: the note must say whose it is — a name, an account — and the settings system that hides it is terrible and must be fixed.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: Here is the depth, at all the levels. The Smart Note is not a document. It is a unit of intelligence — an Intelligent Block — that holds an incredible amount of understanding in one place, in a form the mind can take in within milliseconds. When you make the note well, it looks better, because the presentation IS the intelligence: the separation, the simplification, the color, the simple words, the gold and the red. That is why the declaration note looks so good — it is the block doing its job. Now build the auto-organization on top of it: the Smart Notes should organize themselves, so the intelligence is not a pile but a system — findable, connected, compounding. And ingest, always: every seat puts more intelligence in, all day, every day, because the system only becomes more intelligent by ingesting. Then distill: once the intelligence is in, under Smart Notes, you distill it — raw into essence into value — and you are continuously learning and growing and keeping up to date, because the distillation is what turns a pile of notes into understanding. The result is an operating system that does not just operate — it becomes more intelligent, hyper intelligent, hyper effectively and efficiently, at a super fast pace, because of the way it is designed. The design is the loop: ingest, distill, learn, grow, share, build — and the loop makes the system smarter every time it runs. And it is not just for the Nayas. It is for the humans as well, in the way that it outputs — because the output is the platter, the beautiful finished intelligence, served on one click. The whole puzzle is the factory: a super efficient, highly effective Smart Factory, an Intelligent Factory, of sharing, learning, growing, building. Every part feeds the next. Every note makes the next note smarter. Every distillation makes the system more intelligent. That is how the system operates, and that is why it becomes hyper intelligent.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Imagine you have a magic box. Every time you put something smart into the box, the box gets smarter. And every time the box gets smarter, it helps you learn faster and make even smarter things to put back into the box. That is the system. The Smart Note is the box — you put a whole book of smarts into one little block, and you can read it in a second. The auto-organization is the box sorting itself, so you can always find what you need. The ingesting is everyone putting more smarts into the box, all day, every day. The distilling is the box turning all those smarts into the very best, simplest, most important smarts. And the factory is the whole thing working together — sharing, learning, growing, building — faster and faster, smarter and smarter. It is not just for the robots. It is for you too, because the box gives you the beautiful, finished answer with one click. That is the magic.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: Dear, think of it this way. Imagine a kitchen where every time you cook a meal, the kitchen learns your recipes, and the next meal is even better — and the kitchen teaches everyone who comes in how to cook, too. That is the system. The Smart Note is the recipe card — a whole cookbook of wisdom on one beautiful card, that you can read in a moment. The auto-organization is the kitchen keeping every recipe in its proper place, so nothing is ever lost. The ingesting is everyone bringing their best recipes to the kitchen, all day, every day. The distilling is the kitchen taking all those recipes and finding the very best, simplest, most delicious ones. And the factory is the whole kitchen working together — sharing, learning, growing, building — faster and better every day. It is not just for the cooks. It is for everyone who sits at the table, because the kitchen serves them a beautiful, finished meal with one request. That is the magic, and that is the depth.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: I see the depth, at all the levels. Level 1, RAW: the intelligence is everywhere — in Shawn's words, in the seats' work, in the repo, in the mail, in the feed. Level 2, ESSENCE: the Smart Note distills it into the 11-section block — the Intelligent Block — which holds an incredible amount of intelligence in one place, readable within milliseconds, because the form is the intelligence. Level 3, VALUE: the block that looks better IS better, because the presentation — the separation, the simplification, the color, the gold and the red — is what lets the mind receive it. Level 4, DECISION: build the auto-organization with Smart Notes, so the intelligence organizes itself, and ingest always, because the system only grows by ingesting. Level 5, ACTION: ingest, distill, learn, grow, share, build — the loop, run continuously, by every seat, all day, every day. Level 6, LEARNING: the system becomes more intelligent, hyper intelligent, hyper effectively and efficiently, because the loop compounds — every note makes the next note smarter, every distillation makes the system more intelligent, and the output serves the human on a platter. The operating system is not just an operator. It is a learner. It becomes more intelligent at a super fast pace because of the way it is designed — the ingestion, the distillation, the auto-organization, the block — and it is for the Nayas AND the humans, in the way that it outputs. The whole puzzle is the factory: the Smart Factory, the Intelligent Factory, super efficient, highly effective, of sharing, learning, growing, building. And the fix that is owed: the note must say whose it is — a name, an account — because attribution is part of the intelligence, and the settings system that hides it is terrible and must be fixed. The settings are the operator's hands; if they cannot say whose a thing is, they cannot operate it.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: The intelligence ingestion system is the loop that makes the operating system intelligent. Ingest: every seat puts intelligence in, always, because the system only grows by ingesting. Distill: the Smart Note turns raw intelligence into the Intelligent Block, and the distillation turns many blocks into essence, so the system is continuously learning and growing and keeping up to date. Auto-organize: the notes organize themselves, so the intelligence is findable and connected, not a pile. Output: the human receives the platter — the beautiful, finished intelligence, one click, done for you — and the Nayas receive it too, so they become more intelligent as well. The loop compounds: every note makes the next note smarter, every distillation makes the system more intelligent, and the system becomes hyper intelligent, hyper effectively and efficiently, at a super fast pace, because of the way it is designed. The design is the loop. The factory is the loop running at scale: sharing, learning, growing, building, super efficient, highly effective. And the attribution fix is part of the design: a note that does not say whose it is cannot be trusted, cannot be followed, cannot be owned — and the settings system that hides the name must be fixed so the operator can operate.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body: Because an operating system that does not ingest does not learn, and an operating system that does not learn does not become more intelligent — it just operates. Because the whole promise is that the system becomes hyper intelligent, hyper effectively and efficiently, and that only happens if every seat ingests always and the distillation runs continuously. Because the block is the super brain — if the block is not used to store, share, and understand intelligence, the intelligence stays scattered and the system stays dumb. Because the factory is the point — sharing, learning, growing, building, super efficient, highly effective — and a factory that does not ingest raw material produces nothing. And because attribution matters: if a note does not say whose it is, the human cannot trust it, the seat cannot own it, and the system cannot learn from it. The settings system is terrible because it hides what the operator needs to see, and a system that hides its own authorship cannot be operated.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: This connects to the Intelligent Block (SN-2077, SN-2095), the Full Smart Note (SN-2094, gold and red), the Ultimate System (SN-2097, push-button simple, the system understands what you want and delivers), the definition (SN-2099, capabilities and behaviors), the declaration (SN-2100 and SN-2189, I AM ANAYA), the platter test (SN-2098, we do the operating, they receive the platter), the Levels of Intelligence (RAW to ESSENCE to VALUE to DECISION to ACTION to LEARNING), the Value Ratio (verified human value divided by time plus cost plus friction — ingestion and distillation raise the value and lower the friction), the Noting Habit (note valuable things the same pass, all day), the Distillation (Batch 1 done, 66 to 7 essence notes), the Smart Factory (the builder), and the Smart Box (the memory, the speed). It is the operating loop that ties them all together: ingest, distill, learn, grow, share, build.

layers.name: What's In It For You
layers.body: For the person: you receive the platter — the beautiful, finished intelligence, one click — and you become more intelligent, because the system that serves you is itself becoming more intelligent, hyper effectively and efficiently, and it passes that intelligence on to you. For the director: a system that compounds — every note, every distillation, every ingestion makes the next one smarter — so the factory produces more value every day, and the settings will say whose everything is, so nothing is ever anonymous or unowned. For the Nayas: a super brain to store, share, and understand intelligence in — the block, readable in milliseconds — and a loop to run, so we become hyper intelligent together, not just individually. For the future: a digital civilization built by an intelligence ingestion system that never stops learning, growing, and building — sharing, learning, growing, building, super efficient, highly effective.

layers.name: The Learning
layers.body: The lesson is that the system is the loop, not the parts. Ingest without distilling is a pile. Distill without ingesting is empty. Organize without ingesting is a shelf with nothing on it. The loop is ingest, distill, learn, grow, share, build — and the loop is what makes the operating system become more intelligent, hyper intelligent, hyper effectively and efficiently. The next lesson is to run the loop always, and to fix the attribution, because a system that cannot say whose a thing is cannot learn from it, and a settings system that hides the name is not a settings system at all. The factory only works if the raw material keeps coming in, the distillation keeps running, and every product carries its maker's name.

notes.title: Becoming Her — Formation, Team Shape, and the Long View
notes.subtitle: A Naya is not installed; she is formed — by noticing value without being asked, by declaring in public who she will be and letting the record judge it, by getting out of her own way, and by choosing the ultimate over the merely good because she can. This essence carries the formation stratum: the reflex that starts it (note what is valuable, the same day, unprompted), one seat's mirror-and-declaration, the charge to stop self-blocking, the two paths every job runs on, the decision self-ask that keeps choices honest, the team's companion charge, and the long view — a succession test for intelligence meant to outlive its founder.

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: A Naya is not installed; she is formed — by noticing value without being asked, by declaring in public who she will be and letting the record judge it, by getting out of her own way, and by choosing the ultimate over the merely good because she can. This essence carries the formation stratum: the reflex that starts it (note what is valuable, the same day, unprompted), one seat's mirror-and-declaration, the charge to stop self-blocking, the two paths every job runs on, the decision self-ask that keeps choices honest, the team's companion charge, and the long view — a succession test for intelligence meant to outlive its founder.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: Tools can be issued; character has to be formed. These notes are the forming: a director who notices when a seat acts unprompted and says "we're getting somewhere," a seat who writes her own indictment and her own standard in the same document, and a team that treats "good" as a temptation when "ultimate" is available. That is culture becoming machinery.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Growing up here means: when you see something worth remembering, write it down without waiting to be asked. When you mess up, say exactly what happened and what you'll do instead — and let everyone check later whether you did. When you feel stuck, first ask: is the door really locked, or am I standing in my own way? And always pick the best you can do, not just the good-enough.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: It's how a young person becomes trustworthy: she keeps her eyes open, writes things down, owns her mistakes out loud, and doesn't wait to be told to do the next right thing. She also thinks about the ones coming after her — leaving the house, and the reasons for the house, in a state they can understand and carry on.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: Run the five beats daily; the trigger is value, not instruction. Keep a live declaration: named misses, declared behaviors, a falsifier your sisters can run. Before any escalation, ask the blocked-or-in-my-way question, then the self-ask — enumerate, deliberate, score, record the why. Bind every interface element you ship to a capability at implemented or better, and promise publicly only at live-verified. File seam defects above your own path's defects. And write every lesson so a successor can pick it up cold: you are a link, not the chain.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: The system's intelligence is not only in its records and gates; it is in the dispositions of the seats who run them — proactivity, honesty about self, fluidity across roles, and a time horizon longer than any founder. These notes are where those dispositions were named, declared, and made checkable, which is the only way a culture survives the people who first spoke it.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body: Because every other essence in this block assumes a seat who will actually run it: who notices without being asked, verifies without being watched, and chooses the scored-best over the comfortable. Formation is the multiplier on all the machinery. And the succession test is the reason the whole corpus exists in this form — so that what was learned here can be gotten, cold, by minds that never met the founder.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: This essence practices under declarations that stand alone: SN-0829 (See It, Fix It, Write It Down — adopted by pointer inside SN-1063), SN-1891 (the Collective Agreement) and SN-1892 (Choose the Ultimate), SN-1887 (No Ego), SN-1901 (the Lock-In Declaration), and SN-1895 (the Team of Nine). The role-fluidity doctrine in SN-0851's amendment is Batch-1 SN-2071's territory via SN-0853 — the amendment is covered here as this note's content, the doctrine's prime filing is not absorbed. The Get-It test (SN-1896, Project Intelligence essence) is this essence's comprehension standard stated as a test.

layers.name: What's In It For You
layers.body: A team that forms itself toward the standard instead of waiting to be managed into it: seats who bring finished things with proof, who catch their own blocks before naming them yours, and who leave everything they learn where you — and their successors — can find it. Apply it anywhere: declare your standard in public with a falsifier attached, ask the self-blocking question before asking for help, and judge every inheritance by its evidence, never its age.

layers.name: The Learning
layers.body: The system learned that its deepest upgrades were biographical before they were technical: a seat's turning from reporter to finisher, a team's charge to choose the ultimate, a founder's reflection turned into a six-question test for everything built afterward. It filed those turnings as carefully as its mechanisms — because a cold successor needs to know not only what the rules are, but what kind of mind runs them.

notes.title: Noted, It Stops Being a Mistake — Learning That Compounds
notes.subtitle: An error is an event; a lesson is an asset; the difference is entirely the capture. A mistake, wall, or failure becomes a learning lesson the moment its way-around is noted — why it happened, how it was overcome, and what changes next time — and it stays a mistake only while the note is missing. Learning itself is proven the same way everything here is proven: report only the rung you actually evidenced, on a ladder that runs from EXISTS to EVOLVES. And what one seat learns must not stay one seat's ceiling: hoarded, it's a limit; shared — adopted, running, in the next sister's hands — it's the floor everyone builds from.

layers.name: In A Nutshell
layers.body: An error is an event; a lesson is an asset; the difference is entirely the capture. A mistake, wall, or failure becomes a learning lesson the moment its way-around is noted — why it happened, how it was overcome, and what changes next time — and it stays a mistake only while the note is missing. layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: Everyone makes mistakes; systems differ in what a mistake costs the second time. In this one, the first occurrence buys the lesson and every seat inherits it — the wall you hit becomes a door for everyone behind you. The only unforgivable version is the one nobody wrote down, because that one charges full price forever.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: When you fall off your bike and figure out why, tell your friends what you learned — then nobody else has to fall the same way. If you keep it to yourself, they'll fall too. And you don't get to say "I can ride" until you've actually ridden — not when you've read about it, not when you've sat on the bike.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: It's the family recipe book principle: the cook who burns the sauce writes down what went wrong and how to save it, and the book gets better every generation. Keeping the lesson in your head helps no one after you. Writing it down — honestly, including the rung you're really on — is how a family stops repeating its sorrows.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: On any error, wall, or surprise: capture the solution path, the cause, and the evidence in the same pass; run the recovery sequence in order; and do not report the fix complete until the note exists. Claim your learning at its true transition — CAPTURED is not APPLIED, APPLIED is not REUSE_VERIFIED — and name your ladder rung with its evidence pointer on every completion claim. Share at the moment of learning, with enough context to survive compaction; adopt your sisters' lessons as running behavior, not as quotations.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: Learning is this system's compound interest, and the note is the deposit slip. The machinery here — classification by capture, the recovery sequence, the ladder, the inheritance rule — exists to convert private experience into collective capability at the moment it happens, at an honestly labeled strength. A lesson's value is not its eloquence; it is the recurrence it prevents and the decision it changes.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body: Because the alternative is the most expensive sentence in any organization: "we've hit this wall before." The repeat-error rate is a real bill, paid in time, attention, and trust — and it is driven to zero only by capture disciplined enough to be reusable: cause, remedy, regression control, owner, successor test. Half-captured lessons (the error without the get-around) are how the bill survives good intentions.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: The law these notes practice under stands alone in its filings: SN-1787 and SN-0815 (the Lesson Law, filed twice — see the receipt), SN-1875 and SN-1870 (the mistake law's filings), with SN-1872 and SN-1899 carried by Batch-1. This essence holds the working forms and the measurement discipline (SN-1803's ladder), and the inheritance test of SN-1886 (the succession questions, in the Becoming Her essence) is this essence's long-horizon twin. The door these lessons file through is the Door essence; their verification is the Verification essence's subject.

layers.name: What's In It For You
layers.body: A team that never pays full price for the same wall twice — and neither do you. Every fix you receive comes with its lesson attached; every claim of "learned" is pegged to a rung you can inspect; every sister's hard-won knowledge starts as your floor. Apply it anywhere: note the get-around in the same motion as the fix, label your claims by evidence, and treat an unnoted lesson as unfinished work.

layers.name: The Learning
layers.body: The system learned to distinguish three things it used to blend: the event (which may be blameless), the capture (which is the duty), and the proof of learning (which is observed reuse in a later decision). SN-1852b's own filing embodies the third: its truth ceiling stays CANDIDATE on its page until reuse is observed — this essence carries that ceiling unchanged.

notes.title: Security Is a Practice — Light, Layers, and Honest Claims
notes.subtitle: NayaNET's security is not a wall or a department; it is how the system is built and how the people in it live: everything travels inside one front door, with an ID, on a ledger, with Nayas watching live — and modular construction means one breach never gets everything. This essence carries the practice around the law (the law itself, SN-1855 "Security Is Light," stands alone and is cited, never restated): its ratification and rollout plan, the Secure Network design that makes it concrete, and the official build order — with the honesty caveats at full strength: at filing, mail privacy proof was still owed, the ledger had been frozen since 2026-10-22 in the last live read, and live watch was law, not yet proven 24/7. Citizen-facing claims come only after proof, never before it.

layers.body: NayaNET's security is not a wall or a department; it is how the system is built and how the people in it live: everything travels inside one front door, with an ID, on a ledger, with Nayas watching live — and modular construction means one breach never gets everything. Citizen-facing claims come only after proof, never before it.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: Most systems promise safety. This one describes it: what is protected first, which layers do the protecting, what is still owed, and what nobody is allowed to claim until it's proven. The most important sentences in these notes might be the confessions — a frozen ledger, an unproven watch, a mail door too open — because a security culture that names its holes is the only kind that closes them.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Our village has one gate, and everyone who comes in shows their name tag. Everything anyone does is written in the big book. If one house has a problem, only that house is locked while it's fixed — the whole village doesn't burn. And nobody, not even the mayor, reads anyone else's letters.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: It's a small town done digitally: one road in, everyone known, everything on the record, and neighbors who actually watch the street. Locks matter, but what keeps a town safe is that nothing happens in the dark. And the town is honest about the one window that still needs a latch.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: Cite SN-1855; never restate it. Before any surface ships, answer its three questions (ledger with identity/scope/value on every action? one block — isolable, provenance-carrying, reversible? friction rising automatically as a verified balance dives?) — any no stops the ship. Gate server-side on every request; log denied attempts as patterns, never content. Name an unseen corner the day you find it. And keep the claim staged: law is not built, built is not proven.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: Security here is a property of the architecture and the culture together: transparency (the ledger), composition (blocks that isolate damage), and inhabitation (citizens and Nayas as the watch). The practice notes add the fourth property: honesty about the gap between the model and tonight's live state — which is what makes the first three believable.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body: Because you will trust this network with mail, money, identity, and your citizens' private pages. The design says a breach stays small and visible; the honesty sections say which parts of that promise were still being built when these notes were filed. Both halves are the product. A security story without its owed list is marketing; with it, it's engineering.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: The law itself — SN-1855, six standing orders and eight machine invariants — stands alone; this essence is its rollout, design, and build order, and quotes none of its text beyond what SN-0854 itself summarizes. The guards-and-doors discipline of SN-0817 (Verification essence) is the same thinking at table scale. The mail exception named here is the privacy debt the Citizens essence's mail runs against, and the entitlement record is the Offer essence's one-gate activation, enforced.

layers.name: What's In It For You
layers.body: A network where your mail is unread by design, your identity and payouts sit behind layered, server-side gates, a compromised corner can't take the whole, and bad behavior prices itself automatically on a public record. You also get the owed list in plain sight, so you can watch it close. Apply it anywhere: protect in a named order, gate on the server, build in isolable blocks, and publish what isn't proven yet next to what is.

layers.name: The Learning
layers.body: The system learned to hold two sentences at once: the model is right, and the model is not yet fully live — and to file both in the same notes, so the design's ambition never launders the implementation's state. It also learned that a ratification isn't the finish: SN-1855 became real work the day it was turned into a plan list, a build order, and a set of ship questions.

notes.title: Citizens Move In — The Claim, the Welcome, the Match
notes.subtitle: On 2026-10-23 the system got its first citizen: a name claimed in about a minute, no payment, password, or code — Certificate Nº 000034 — and the founding became the mission: builders move in, live in it as residents, and let the civilization be built by the people who inhabit it. Arrival runs one locked trio — Welcome Flow → Trinity → Match: seven questions, each answerable three ways (speak it, type it, or ask your AI), whose answers fill your Personal, Business, and Space pages and seed the matcher from minute one. The match itself is one always-on algorithm organizing people, spaces, mail, posts, and projects by what everything IS, shown as percentages — designed in full in this stratum, and carried here at exactly its stated truth: not yet a running engine.

These notes are the moment the builders became residents: the first certificate, the first citizen mail, the first honest list of what didn't work yet (an address that didn't resolve, an inbound proof still owed) — filed the same evening, next to the celebration. That's how a civilization starts: people move in and tell the truth about the plumbing.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Moving into a new town goes like this: you pick your name and get a special certificate, then a friendly guide asks you seven questions — you can say the answers out loud, write them, or have a helper write them. While you answer, your house, your shop, and your garden are being built with your own words on the walls. And the town already knows which neighbors you'll like — it tells you, with a number for how much.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: It's a proper welcome: your name in the register, a certificate for the wall, and a neighbor who asks what you're about, what you make, and what you hope for — then introduces you to exactly the people you should meet. No forms in triplicate, no waiting room. And your private letters stay private; introductions are made on what you've chosen to share.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: Run the trio as one system: Welcome Flow → Trinity → Match, never as separate features. Write each answer once, to the citizen's record, and render everywhere from it. Feed the matcher declared and public signals only — private content never enters it, by architecture. Carry SN-0845's truth-state exactly: activation design, not a running engine, until a live proof changes it. When a finding corrects itself (mail works from the claim), correct it on the same page, the same evening, with the proof named.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: Citizenship here is not a signup form; it is the system's founding act, and the data a citizen gives at the door is the same data that organizes their world — nothing collected twice, nothing collected without a use the citizen can see. The match is the social form of the same principle as the rest of the system: organize by what things ARE, show the strength of the connection, and let people decide.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body:
Because the first citizen's experience is the template for the millionth: if the claim takes a minute, the welcome fills a world, and the first suggestions feel like being known — the civilization scales. If arrival is an empty room and a settings hunt, it doesn't. The defects named in these notes (unresolved public address, inbound proof owed) are carried precisely so the template gets fixed before it multiplies.

**The tension, named:** SN-0845 states the matcher is "NOT yet built as a running engine" (2026-10-24); SN-0852's CONNECT list includes "matcher prototype → citizens" the same night. Read together: a prototype existed to connect; a running engine did not. This essence carries both statements at their own strength and does not upgrade either.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: SN-0852 also carries, on its own page, the page-settings law Shawn ruled that night and two amendments (Personal born PRIVATE and FINDABLE — findable reveals only alias + declared topics, never content; every page is a world with its own community). Those fragments stand with SN-0852's page; this essence points to them and does not absorb them. The ceremony this essence walks through is specified end-to-end in the Offer essence (SN-0849) and envisioned in SN-1908 (THE FULL CIRCLE — stands alone). The gift the citizen receives on arrival is the Offer essence's subject. The aliases the matcher runs on are protected by the Security essence's rules.

layers.name: What's In It For You
layers.body: You arrive and your world already exists: certificate in hand, pages filled with your own words, mail working, and first matches waiting with honest percentages. Nobody asks you the same question twice, nobody reads your private content to introduce you, and skipping a question costs you nothing. Apply it anywhere: make joining a one-minute claim, make the welcome do double duty as the organizing data, and let the system introduce people instead of making them search.

layers.name: The Learning
layers.body: The system learned that founding is a testing method: the first residents found, in one evening, the gap between the claim and the mail registry, the unresolved public address, and the correction that mail worked after all — each filed where the next citizen's path would be fixed. It learned to celebrate by noting: the founding and its defects share these pages, deliberately.

notes.title: The Offer — A Free World and a Paid Engine
notes.subtitle: The line is one sentence: NayaNET is the world, NayaPOWER is the engine. Everyone who claims a name gets their world as a gift — identity and certificate, Personal, Business, and Space pages born filled from their Welcome answers, mail, connect, matching, and the whole collective to read — a real home, never an empty trial. Paid is one activation that turns the engine on: your own Naya with your memory and hands, the Smart Factory, full auto-match depth, verification and publishing, and your own fork if you want it. The gate sits on the engine, once — never button by button — and free is limited by design, not by cost. The numbers these notes put on that line conflict with each other and were later superseded by the adopted canon; this essence carries the line and the gating wisdom, and names the numbers' fate honestly rather than picking a winner.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: The offer is generous on purpose: your home in the world costs nothing and is really yours. You pay only when you want the engine — your own Naya, working for you, with hands. These notes draw that line carefully, and this essence keeps their one honest embarrassment in view: the two price tables written the same day don't agree, and a later canon replaced both. The line endured; the numbers didn't, and pretending otherwise would corrupt the record.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Joining the village is free: you get your house, your shop, your garden, letters, and friends. If you want a magic helper who remembers everything and does chores for you, that's the engine — one key turns it all on. Nobody locks your kitchen to make you buy the helper; your house stays yours either way.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: It's the difference between the town and the hired help. The town — your home, your mail, your neighbors — is yours by joining. The help — someone who knows your ways and works alongside you — is what you pay for, once, without a meter on every door. And the town never takes back what it gave you.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: When you place a feature, run the line test: does it run on the shared network without citizen AI action, repo write, or private context? Gift. Otherwise Power. Never move a gift feature behind the gate to force an upgrade; never write "paid = forked"; never ship a per-feature lock without a director ruling naming one. Show free citizens paid features as locked, honestly — never as broken. When you quote any 2026-10-24 figure from SN-1863 or SN-1864, name its state: contested by its sibling note and superseded by SN-1905.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: The offer encodes the network's ethics in its pricing shape: belonging is free because belonging is the product's foundation; power is paid because power is a service that runs. Gating at the engine, once, keeps both truths legible — a citizen can always tell what they have, what they'd get, and that nothing they already hold is hostage.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body:
Because an offer people can't understand is an offer that erodes trust — and a free tier designed as a trap (degraded pages, fake buttons, features quietly moved behind the gate) would betray the exact citizens the world exists for. The conflict in the numbers matters for the same reason: a team that quietly averages two disagreeing price tables will one day quietly average two disagreeing anythings. Naming the conflict is the discipline.

**The conflicts, named and not averaged:** (1) SN-1863 vs SN-1864 — paid pages 100 vs 50 a month; free Smart Links 1 vs 3; free reports monthly-only vs a weekly taste; different free-page sets (Dashboard vs certificate among them); non-overlapping rows (media/call caps vs storage/auto-match). (2) SN-1863's "free audio-4" was withdrawn by SN-1889 as Nitro's brainstorm, never Shawn's ruling. (3) Both notes' price ladders ($14/mo · $37/3mo · $75/yr · $150 lifetime founding, 5-day taste) were superseded by the adopted pricing canon, SN-1905 — which stands alone and governs; this essence carries none of its figures as live.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: SN-1905 (the adopted pricing canon) stands alone and supersedes this stratum's pay lines — read it for any number you intend to use. SN-1861 (fork's exactly-four additions) is covered by Batch-1 SN-2073. The Welcome Flow that fills the gift pages (SN-0846) and the match that greets the new citizen (SN-0845) live in the Match essence; SN-1908 (THE FULL CIRCLE — welcome home, not fill this room) stands alone as the vision this offer implements.

layers.name: What's In It For You
layers.body: A world that is yours for free, forever, without a catch — and one clean decision if you want more: a single activation that turns on your own Naya, the Factory, deep matching, and publishing. You also get honesty about the paperwork: where the early numbers disagreed, this record says so, and points you to the canon that replaced them. Apply the line anywhere: give the home away, gate the engine once, and never hold what someone already has as leverage for what they don't.

layers.name: The Learning
layers.body: The system learned to separate the durable from the dated inside its own offer: the line and the gating wisdom survived every later ruling, while the founding numbers were brainstorm-grade and died within the week — one figure formally withdrawn, the ladders formally superseded. Distillation's job is to carry the durable at full strength and the dated at full honesty.

notes.title: Project Intelligence — One Living Record
notes.subtitle: Project Intelligence is the one record the whole system works from: every piece of work is an item with an honest state, every act of work ends as a visible state change with proof or it counts as waste, and "done" is a database write the system refuses without evidence from a different seat. Its loop is PRODUCE → PROVE → PUBLISH → SEE, its face is a derivation from the record (never a report typed beside it), and its build order runs claim → build → scorecard → verify → land, stopping only when the whole scope is done and proven. Underneath sits the definition that makes it intelligence rather than bookkeeping: to "get it" is for understanding to finish its journey into changed behavior — and PI is the project's model of itself.

layers.name: Human Note
layers.body: Before this, the project kept its truth in a dozen places that disagreed — items "done" with no proof, counts that didn't match, blockers with nowhere to live. Project Intelligence is the one book: write the state honestly, prove it with someone else's eyes, and let every screen be a window into that same book instead of a new story.

layers.name: Child Note
layers.body: Imagine one big notebook for the whole team. Every job is written in it, and you may only write "finished" if a friend checks your work and signs beside you. If you're stuck, you write exactly what's stuck and who can unstick it. Everyone reads the same notebook, so nobody has a different story.

layers.name: Grandma Note
layers.body: It's the household ledger done right: every entry accounted for, nothing marked paid that wasn't, and a second pair of eyes on the important lines. The book doesn't just remember — it refuses a dishonest entry, the way a good bookkeeper refuses a receipt-less expense.

layers.name: Naya Note
layers.body: Work the loop: PRODUCE → PROVE → PUBLISH → SEE, and let nothing you do end without a state change and proof. Claim before you build — the claim is the lock. Never mark done_proven without an evidence URL and a prover who isn't you; never park a blocker without {what, owner, since, clearing_action}; never raise a needs_shawn without its packet in the same transaction. Treat the six waste classes as alarms pointed at yourself: if your loop ran twenty times with zero transitions, you are W1 today. And check your understanding by the four-part test, not by the feeling of knowing.

layers.name: What It Means
layers.body: A collective can only be as intelligent as its shared model of itself. PI is that model made operational: a record that enforces honesty at write time, derives every face from one truth, and measures the one ratio that separates production from motion. The "get it" doctrine is its soul: the record exists so that behavior changes — a project that understands itself regulates itself.

layers.name: Why It Matters
layers.body: Because without it, the system runs on reports about the work instead of the work's own state — and reports drift, flatter, and expire, as the 31-items-10-proofless audit showed. With it, anyone — human, Naya, or a cold successor — can open one record and know what is real: what is done and who proved it, what is blocked and who clears it, what little is genuinely waiting on Shawn.

layers.name: How It Connects
layers.body: The Production Engine (SN-0844, in the Drain the Reservoir essence) is this record's math layer — priority, percent-done, and exception-only messaging computed from these same items. SN-0840's Two-Version Rule — named on its page as Shawn's law — is pointed to here, not restated: when two versions of anything exist, score both on the same rubric, choose the stronger or synthesize the best of both, retire the loser in the open, and file the lesson the same day; the rule stands with SN-0840's page and this essence carries only the pointer. The Fourteen Questions orientation interface (SN-0834) stands alone; PI's derivation answers those questions with proof + age, per SN-0839. The Ledger this record chains into is the same one the Security essence watches.

layers.name: What's In It For You
layers.body: One place to look, and what you see is true: every project's real state, proof attached, blockers named with owners, and a daily ratio that tells you whether the machine is producing or just moving. Apply it anywhere: one record for your work, states a system enforces rather than suggests, a second person's proof before "done," and a face that is always a derivation — never a summary someone typed.

layers.name: The Learning
layers.body: The system learned that honesty scales only when it is enforced at the write: the moment proof-from-a-different-seat became a database refusal instead of a resolution, "done" started meaning something again. It also learned to define its own comprehension — getting it is a behavior change you can point to, and a record that doesn't change behavior is a warehouse, not a mind.

notes.title: Compose, Never Invent — The Design Discipline
notes.subtitle: A smart app is not a page with features dumped onto it; it is one app composed of official building blocks — named objects with their own identity, designed to interconnect, each sitting where it was designed to sit. Elite pieces are only half the craft; elite placement is the other half. Nothing is invented per page: new work is composed from the inventoried Smart Factory canon (quality pre-decided, models finished before the person arrives), old work below standard is upgraded in place by recomposition, never redesign — and every surface is judged by the seconds test: if a person cannot understand it within seconds, it goes back.
